jobs.title: Marketing Manager, Digital Ads ADA Program, Amazon Digital Ads: Direct Access
jobs.excerpt:
Join Amazon's Display Advertising team to build meaningful partnerships with internal business teams while shaping the future of digital marketing. You'll provide strategic guidance on campaign management, technical support, and best practices—directly influencing how Amazon reaches and engages customers across web, mobile, video, and audio formats. Key job responsibilities Develop and maintain strategic partnerships with internal business teams by providing consultative support, technical guidance, and industry best practices to help them achieve their advertising objectives Deliver comprehensive onboarding and ongoing education to ensure teams can effectively use our advertising platform and continuously optimize their campaigns Analyze campaign performance data and provide actionable recommendations to improve results, identifying trends and opportunities across multiple campaigns and business units Serve as the primary technical point of contact for troubleshooting issues, managing support requests, and ensuring timely resolution of platform-related challenges Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather client feedback, identify platform improvements, and help shape the evolution of our tools and processes A day in the life As a Marketing Manager supporting our Display Advertising program, you'll be the trusted advisor for internal business teams navigating our advertising platform. Your day might include conducting training sessions to help teams maximize campaign performance, analyzing real-time campaign data to identify optimization opportunities, and collaborating with product and engineering teams to refine our tools based on client feedback. You'll troubleshoot technical challenges, mentor teams on industry best practices, and work across time zones to support global business initiatives. Beyond routine support, you'll contribute to defining how we evolve our platform by synthesizing patterns from client interactions and translating them into actionable recommendations for our product and technology teams. About the team We're building solutions that enable Amazon's digital marketing vision—helping internal teams effectively reach their audiences while contributing to Amazon's broader advertising ecosystem. Our team combines marketing expertise with data-driven decision-making to develop and scale programs that drive customer acquisition and lifetime value. We work collaboratively across Marketing, Product Management, Engineering, Analytics, and Finance to create tools and processes that make digital advertising more accessible and impactful. You'll join a results-oriented group committed to pushing the boundaries of digital formats and delivering exceptional service to the teams we support.

Basic qualifications:
- 4+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience - Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements - Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables) - Experience building and optimizing multiple, simultaneous marketing campaigns - Experience managing or working within cross-functional marketing and creative teams

Preferred qualifications:

jobs.title: Customer Marketing Specialist, Global Customer References Team
jobs.excerpt:
As a Customer Marketing Specialist, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of customer storytelling — from discovering and vetting customer success stories against strategic criteria to amplifying them across marketing channels for maximum impact. You will work cross-functionally with product marketing, industry marketing, PR, content teams, campaigns, demand generation, and account teams to ensure strategic alignment and high-quality storytelling at scale. The ideal candidate has a passion for customer-centric storytelling, the ability to transform complex technical concepts into compelling narratives, and experience building and improving scalable mechanisms to deliver results. A proven track record of managing cross-functional content programs and influencing without direct authority is essential. Key job responsibilities Own the end-to-end lifecycle of customer references from identifying and vetting customer stories against strategic criteria (industry relevance, quantifiable outcomes, AWS differentiation, narrative arc) to recommending top candidates for campaigns, keynotes, and media opportunities. Curate and manage priority customer stories by product, industry, and strategic theme; enforce high-quality criteria promoting impact over volume; brief executives and enable stakeholder teams with ready-to-use reference materials. Facilitate regular touchpoints with stakeholders, content strategists, campaign managers, PR, and account teams. Establish and lead working groups to surface stories, align on priorities, and coordinate storytelling efforts across the organization. Draft and produce customer case studies, executive summaries, reference slide copy, headlines, and talking points according to AWS style guidelines and storytelling best practices. Write technical case studies and support video storytelling production. Identify opportunities to leverage AI for operational excellence and content production at scale. Build, test, and iterate on AI-powered tools to accelerate content creation while maintaining quality standards. Design and execute promotion plans for customer assets in partnership with video, social, web, and campaign teams. Coordinate customer story placement across channels to maximize reach and impact. Champion internal platform adoption for customer reference management; define requirements for platform improvements; ensure customer stories are properly logged, searchable, and accessible to stakeholders. A day in the life This role is part storyteller, part program manager, part creative strategist — and it moves fast. If you love connecting people, finding the signal in the noise, and making customers the hero, you'll thrive here.

jobs.title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager, Capital
jobs.excerpt:
Who we are 
 About Stripe 
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. 
 About the team 
 Growth Marketing is a team of performance-driven marketers and channel specialists. We partner closely with growth product, regional and demand marketing, and sales to drive revenue through self-serve and sales motions. We work globally, on the full customer lifecycle, and with all company segments - from startups to the largest enterprises. This role is focused on driving growth for Stripe Capital. 
 Stripe Capital provides access to fast, flexible financing to businesses, with the mission of helping them accelerate their growth. Businesses use the funds for marketing, hiring, geographic expansion, working capital, new equipment purchases, and much more. Capital has scaled meaningfully over the last few years, both in terms of user impact (over 81,000 businesses received financing through Stripe Capital in 2025 alone) as well as financial impact as a business line within Stripe. Over 95% of our users say they love using Capital, making us one of the most popular products at Stripe—and we're just getting started. 
 What you’ll do 
 As a Lifecycle Marketing Manager, you will be a key driver of global marketing efforts supporting our self-serve user acquisition motions to drive demand and revenue growth for Capital — designing, implementing, and optimizing scaled, global lifecycle campaigns across user segments and life stages. You will help create uncommonly great email marketing campaigns and multi-channel experiences for Capital through a relentless focus on user experience and channel optimization. 
 Responsibilities 
 
 Drive ideation, strategy, and execution of scaled lifecycle campaigns across email and in-product notifications to drive core business outcomes (e.g. new user acquisition, product activation, revenue), and test into and scale new channels (direct mail, push notifications, etc)  
 Identify customer needs, ideate solutions to improve user experience, and generate ongoing user-driven insights to inform campaign strategy and optimization 
 Leverage marketing automation, behavioral data, and ML-based techniques to create personalized experiences at scale 
 Analyze trends, develop actionable insights to optimize against targets, and socialize relevant learnings across the organization 
 Collaborate closely with key stakeholders across Growth, Product, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Sales, and Marketing 
 
 Who you are 
 We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. 
 Minimum requirements 
 
 7+ years of work experience in a marketing role designing and launching multi-channel campaigns 
 5+ years of experience analyzing and taking action on the performance of marketing campaigns 
 5+ years of experience writing marketing briefs 
 3+ years of experience leveraging data, AI, and ML-driven techniques 
 3+ years of B2B marketing experience 
 3+ years of email marketing, direct mail, and push notification experience 
 
 Preferred qualifications 
 
 Experience with Marketo, Salesforce, and/or Salesloft 
 Experience working in fintech on lending products

jobs.title: Enterprise Business Development Representative
jobs.excerpt:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy. 
 The Enterprise segment is seeking a new Business Development Representative (BDR) to help generate a quality pipeline for our Account Executives focused on our Regional Mid-Market business segment. You will help build the pipeline by strategically prospecting and nurturing opportunities in accounts with 41-499 locations.  This role is a great opportunity to develop outbound and phone skills by delivering a consultative platform pitch to C-suite, VP, and Director level positions across departments like IT, Operations, Accounting/Finance & Marketing. You will have the opportunity to work in a fast paced team with varied future customers and personalized training and career opportunities. 
 You will gain exposure to the Enterprise sales process and work cross-functionally with many segments of our team including Senior Management, Marketing, Sales Operations, Sales Engineering, Services & Support, etc.  You will also work closely with seasoned Account Executives to develop targeted prospecting strategies in their assigned markets. 
 A day in the life (Responsibilities)   
 
 Generate new business pipeline primarily through outbound prospecting (2+ new business qualified sales opportunities per month) 
 Gain interest through outbound cold calling across a set of accounts/prospects and breaking into net new logos in assigned territory (65+ activities per day) 
 Schedule discovery calls, demos, on-sites and follow-up calls (owning the process until calls or meetings occur) 
 Leverage existing tools and research to find new contacts to develop your call-base 
 Focused efforts promoting new products to prospects 
 Multi-threading and account mapping within large restaurant brands corporate teams and franchisees  
 Persistent, organized follow-up with nurture contacts/accounts to re-engage on a next step (bring them back to the table!) 
 Entering activity, notes, company account info and updating opportunities in Salesforce 
 Work effectively with assigned AEs on a daily/weekly/monthly basis on maintaining target account lists and prospecting strategies 
 Provide input in the design of & help in the execution of enterprise marketing efforts (campaigns, trade-shows, etc) 
 
 What you'll need to thrive (Requirements): 
 
 Software/SaaS experience or other related tech space business experience in an outbound or closing role 
 Previous outbound and inbound sales experience 
 Fearless on the phone and persistent in initial reach out & follow-up with accounts over time  
 Ability to identify key decision makers within new accounts, while aligning with internal account reps 
 Well organized, self-motivated to make calls everyday and communicate effectively with internal teams and prospects in a productive manner 
 Adaptable to new processes and ability to work cross-functionally and develop relationships with both internal and external stakeholders  
 High customer empathy and the ability to handle objections 
 Attention to detail and ability to thrive in a changing and evolving environment 
 Demonstrate verbal and written skill sets in communication 
 
 Special Skills (Nonessential Skills/Nice to Haves): 
 
 Restaurant experience  
 MEDDPICC certified 
 Command of the Message 
 Experience using Nooks, Salesforce, Zoominfo, LeadIQ, Claude/Gemini, Linkedin Sales Navigator  
 
 AI at Toast 
 At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture. 
 Our Total Rewards Philosophy We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https://careers.toasttab.com/toast-benefits . The estimated Total Targeted Cash compensation range for this role is listed below. Total Targeted Cash for this role includes base salary, commission, and bonus (if eligible). This role qualifies for uncapped commissions. The starting salary will be determined based on skills, experience, and geographic location. In addition to cash compensation, our total rewards components include benefits and equity (if eligible). You can learn more about how we align pay with local labor markets in our Geographic Pay Zone Philosophy . We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more: https://careers.toasttab.com/ai-in-hiring 
 Our Approach to Hybrid Working We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region:  https://careers.toasttab.com/locations-toast 
 People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success 
 At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient—when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry brings together people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we value that same breadth at Toast. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work—raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other.

jobs.excerpt:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking an experienced Partner Marketing Manager to build awareness, create demand and drive revenue with Global System Integrator (GSI) and Multi-national SI/Consulting Partners in North America. This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in an exciting, fast growing business. This position will be managing the strategic marketing plans for 4-6 large System Integrator, Reseller or Consulting partners. The ideal candidate needs to be able to drive strategic, comprehensive, marketing plans at the highest levels of the organization. Marketing experience with a breadth of channel partners is a must. The goals for this position are to collaborate with the dedicated sales team to design, develop, implement, and measure successful marketing programs that help meet the account objectives. They need to drive partner generated leads, maximize marketing funds, and acquire new customers. The candidate will have a demonstrated history of building and executing high-impact, data-driven marketing programs with and through large consulting partners. They should be able to build foundational marketing mechanisms, while thinking big on behalf of their customer/partner. They will have experience partnering closely with sales teams to deliver joint account content and programs. They will have excellent interpersonal and written communication skills, executive presence, as well as project and account management skills. They will be expected to 1/ Develop and own the strategic marketing plan for the partner. 2/ Develop a comprehensive annual marketing strategy and plan that is aligned with GTMs, partner marketing, and global marketing counterparts. 3/ Plan and deliver demand generation programs executed with the partner to acquire new customers, including integrated campaigns, events, and digital marketing. 4/ Work closely with the GTMS organization to understand their priorities and enable them to meet their objectives with focused lead gen activities. 6/ Participates as key stakeholder and business partner with the Americas GTMS, partner marketing, and field marketing leadership. This includes participating in business reviews, providing monthly and quarterly marketing updates, and providing ongoing updates to key stakeholder’s teams. The ideal candidate will have creative marketing ideas to combine with extensive analytic and data-driven customer demand generation experience working at a technology company or Global System Integrator. They should be detail-oriented and organized, capable of handling multiple projects at once, and comfortable dealing with ambiguity and rapidly changing priorities. They will work closely with the partners and the partner sales team to identify specific customer segments and industry verticals to market to with a joint value proposition for adopting AWS. This role requires excellent collaboration and relationship-building skills as they will be required to engage with Product Marketing, Global & Regional Partner Marketing Teams, the AWS Sponsorship Teams, the Partner Sales and Solution Architect organization to execute marketing programs for the Americas. They will be the voice of our partner and customer needs into various internal stakeholders and will share best practices across regions. In addition, they will also be required to manage outside vendors to execute programs and achieve goals, including not limited to, managing Account Based Marketing programs, broad-scale partner programs, etc. They will be expected to Develop and own the Americas strategic marketing plan to drive demand for AWS solutions with new and existing customers, focused on Mid-Market and Enterprise segments. Key job responsibilities • Work closely with global Partner Marketing, Field Marketing and Partner Business Development (PDM) sales teams to align priorities and develop partner marketing initiatives. • Define annual joint marketing strategies, objectives and measures of success with the SI partner's marketing team • Develop and execute best-in-class partner co-marketing plans that effectively drive awareness and adoption of AWS compute services • Manage annual partner marketing budget- generating partner-led opportunities, tracking accruals, marketing spend and reimbursement claims About the team The North America Partner Marketing team works with top AWS Consulting Partners to develop and execute marketing strategies that align to the partner sales objectives and generate AWS partner-led opportunities. The Sr. PMM will work across many stakeholders to include the partner in appropriate AWS-led marketing motions and amplify the partners’ unique value-add. The Sr. PMM will plan and execute marketing campaigns and measure ROI. This role requires tight alignment with regional partner development managers (PDMs) and global counterparts.

jobs.title: Americas Field Marketing, AI
jobs.excerpt:
About Stripe 
 Stripe's infrastructure and suite of APIs powers hundreds of thousands of businesses—from startups to Fortune 500s—in almost every country around the world. From developers and product managers to founders and CFOs, a broad audience interacts with Stripe's products and uses them to start, run, and scale their companies. Removing the barriers to online commerce helps more new businesses get started, expedites growth for existing companies, and increases economic output and trade globally. 
 We operate at a significant scale, but we're still tiny relative to the opportunity ahead, so there is still much to do. Join us and help put the global economy within everyone's reach. 
 Role Overview 
 We're seeking an experienced, creative, and results-oriented marketer who knows the AI ecosystem to drive world-class field marketing for AI organizations in the Americas region. This field marketer will be responsible for executing marketing strategies that delivers growth and revenue at scale for AI businesses. The ideal candidate is data-driven, relentlessly seeks to optimize, stays at the cutting edge of modern marketing practices, and has a passion for collaborating with sales teams to drive successful customer outcomes. As a member of the Americas Marketing team, this is a great opportunity to build and have a significant impact on our rapidly growing business. 
   
 About the Team  
 The Americas Marketing team is a high-performing group laser-focused on fueling Stripe's expansion across the region. You'll have the opportunity to make a significant impact by building and optimizing programs and strategies. You'll collaborate closely with cross-functional partners in Sales, Product, Partnerships, and others to drive measurable business results and growth. 
   
 You will: 
 
 Execute the regional field marketing strategy and plan to fuel pipeline growth with the AI sales teams across the Americas 
 Monitor key business and revenue metrics, providing cross-functional insights to drive continuous optimization and improvement 
 Partner closely with Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Partnerships teams to develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns 
 Develop and implement an events strategy, including third-party and Stripe-hosted events (in-person, virtual, and hybrid) that will deliver results for the AI segment 
 Design and execute mid- and lower-funnel Account Based Marketing programs to accelerate leads, opportunities, and revenue growth 
 Develop a focus on acquiring contacts in AI organizations by creating compelling plans, offers and approaches to effectively engage this cohort 
 Leverage Stripe's marketing tech stack and analytics capabilities to drive data-driven decision-making and optimize the field marketing engine 
 
 We’re looking for someone with: 
 
 3-5 years of relevant B2B field marketing experience, executing regional strategies including Account Based Marketing 
 Proven track record of executing marketing programs and events that drive new customer acquisition and pipeline growth 
 Expertise in developing and executing scaled and targeted multi-channel marketing campaigns across the full funnel 
 Experience working in both digital and in-person event environments, with a deep understanding of how to integrate event experiences into the buyer's journey 
 Successful track record of collaborating with Sales teams, including joint planning, lead management, and earning trust as a strategic partner 
 Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills with ability to synthesize and communicate business health with leadership 
 Excellent communication, collaboration, and project management capabilities 
 Startup mentality with a bias for action and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment

jobs.title: GTM Product Marketing Manager, Commerce Experiences
jobs.excerpt:
Who we are 
 About Stripe 
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. 
 About the team 
 The GTM Product Marketing team sits within Stripe's Product Marketing org. We make sure Stripe sellers walk into every conversation prepared, confident, and armed with the right story. As Stripe's center of excellence for general product enablement, we set the standard for how sellers learn and pitch our products, drive consistency across product suites, and act as Marketing's Voice of the Field — surfacing seller insights to sharpen upstream messaging and positioning. We translate product value into seller-ready narratives, resources, and enablement — and we measure our impact on seller confidence and how effectively our teams pitch, qualify, and close. 
 Stripe's Commerce Experiences products (Optimized Checkout Suite, Link, Terminal, Agentic Commerce) help businesses convert more customers across every channel — from online checkout, to digital wallets, to in-person commerce, to the emerging world of AI-driven shopping. We're looking for an exceptional GTM product marketer to bring Stripe's story to market. In this role, you'll be the connective tissue between product, marketing, and the field. You'll translate complex commerce and checkout capabilities into compelling narratives and seller resources that resonate with our users and drive adoption. You'll equip customer-facing teams to confidently pitch all our solutions, answer technical questions, and speak to the roadmap. You'll also elevate seller and field insights to refine product positioning and messaging. 
 What you’ll do 
 As the GTM PMM for Commerce Experiences, you’ll need to quickly build a deep understanding of Stripe’s Commerce Experiences products, buyer personas, and differentiation. You will: 
 
 Own the content development and GTM enablement strategy across the sold funnel — creating seller-ready resources (pitch decks, FAQs, value props, talking points) that translate product positioning into clear, differentiated customer value propositions for enterprise, mid-market, and platform buyers. 
 Partner with Market Intelligence to monitor and understand commerce, checkout, and emerging agentic commerce market trends, competitive dynamics, and seller-facing competitive narratives — synthesize insights, and leverage these to build differentiated positioning. 
 Design and deliver training programs that build seller expertise across the Commerce Experiences portfolio. 
 Prepare sellers for major product launch events like Stripe Sessions, and to understand the details of the roadmap product is building. 
 Leverage data and insights to identify enablement and knowledge gaps, prioritize asset development, launch new content, and measure effectiveness on seller confidence and other KPIs. 
 Surface field insights on a regular cadence — through monthly readouts and structured retros — to inform core PMM positioning and product roadmap. 
 
 Minimum requirements 
 
 3+ years of product marketing experience, preferably in B2B tech. 
 Direct experience with checkout, ecommerce, digital wallets, agentic commerce or other commerce platforms is strongly preferred.  
 Experience with Enterprise sales cycles and technical products. 
 Excellent communication and presentation abilities, with a proven track record of distilling complex strategies into clear, compelling narratives. 
 Strong stakeholder management skills. 
 Ability to move quickly without compromising attention to detail or polish. 
 A self-starter who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously. 
 Comfort with data-driven decision making and measuring marketing impact. 
 Ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders across Product, Sales, and Marketing, and contribute to alignment on shared goals. 
 
 Preferred qualifications 
 
 Demonstrated comfort working with, and presenting to, senior leaders across a variety of disciplines. 
 Strong collaboration skills, a tendency to seek and share alternative views, and an ability to earn stakeholder confidence  
 Experience using or building AI-powered tooling to accelerate seller productivity or content development.

jobs.title: Marketing Manager, Amazon Grocery, Amazon Grocery
jobs.excerpt:
We're looking for a Marketing Manager to own content and placement execution across the Amazon Grocery storefront. This role sits on the WWGS Amazon Grocery Marketing team, which is responsible for devising full-funnel strategy, marketing tooling, automation, and performance in a One Grocery context to deliver a seamless shopping experience for our customers. You'll own application and merchandising guidance of the grocery style guide, integrated campaign moderation workflows, campaign efficacy tracking and testing execution, along with supporting key other business initiatives. This is a role for someone who can manage multiple projects under ambiguity where the objective is defined but the path may require complex, cross-functional solutions. Key job responsibilities -Own the launch and management of critical marketing projects to hit customer funnel, revenue, and profitability goals. -Own campaign performance reporting for the business. -Own campaign moderation workflows, driving quality, approval rates, and content standards. -Design and run storefront testing programs, building testing frameworks where none exist and turning learnings into repeatable, scalable page guidelines. -Run marketing performance deep dives, analyzing metrics to find growth opportunities and inform strategy. -Own team intake mechanism and content calendar, aligning to trade planning guidance. -Drive improvements and automation (including AI-based tooling) to streamline content execution across teams. -Plan and develop clear requirements, communicate effectively with senior stakeholders, proactively surface risks, and clear blockers. -Lead recurring forums and mechanisms for knowledge sharing and alignment across NA and partner teams. -Participate in recruiting and hiring

Basic qualifications:
- 4+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience - Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements - Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables) - Experience using Microsoft Excel to manipulate and analyze data - Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional programs or marketing campaigns from concept to completion - Experience producing marketing promotional material for Owned & Operated channels - Experience in brand identity and voice development - Experience creating brand marketing content

Preferred qualifications:
- Experience using customer research, hard data and metrics to back up assumptions, generate forecasts, and assess the efficacy of marketing programs - Experience utilizing systems and tools involving email, web, analytics, and CRM (Marketo, Tableau, Salesforce, etc.) for targeting, segmentation, reporting for demand generation Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. jobs.title: Outbound Business Development Representative (BDR)
jobs.excerpt:
🚀 Join HubSpot as an Outbound Business Development Representative (BDR)  📍 Remote (USA) or Cambridge, MA, USA 
 We’ll be honest — sales isn’t easy, and it’s not for everyone. But for those who love a challenge, thrive on results, and want to launch a long-term path in sales, it’s incredibly rewarding . 
 If you’re looking to “try out” sales or just dip a toe in, this probably isn’t the role for you. But, if you’re the kind of person who wakes up hungry to compete, thrives on setting and smashing goals, and wants to build a career in tech sales from the ground up — we want to talk to you. 
 At HubSpot, our BDRs are not only the first point of contact for our prospects—they’re also developing the skills and mindset to become our next generation of Account Executives. This is not a placeholder job — it’s the first chapter of a high-growth sales career designed for those who want to build skills, embrace feedback, move fast, and grow even faster. 
 The Role: As an Outbound BDR , you’ll play a key role in HubSpot’s growth engine. You'll be the first touchpoint for many of our future customers, sparking conversations through strategic outreach, uncovering pain points, and qualifying leads. You’ll partner closely with Account Executives to deliver high-quality meetings that drive pipeline, impact, and revenue. Along the way, you’ll sharpen your sales toolkit daily and gain exposure to a world-class sales organization. 
 Compensation & Career Track: This is the first of three levels in our BDR program — designed to take you from prospecting pro to promoting to a full-cycle closer. 💰 Base salary: $53,800 annually 📈 On-target commission: $23,000 annually 🎯 OTE (on-target earnings): $76,800 annually With each promotion, both salary and commission increase — along with your impact. 
 What You’ll Do: 
 
 Own and execute outbound prospecting through high-volume outreach (60–100+ activities/day) via phone, email, and LinkedIn. 
 Collaborate with Account Executives to target strategic accounts and refine outreach strategy. 
 Qualify leads based on fit, need, and urgency — and book quality discovery meetings. 
 Hit (and exceed) KPIs for activity, meetings delivered, and pipeline impact. 
 Grow fast. Learn fast. Get coached. Apply it. Repeat. 
 
 What You Won’t Do: 
 
 Coast. We move fast, we test, we iterate, and we compete. 
 Wait for someone to tell you what to do. We value self-starters who take ownership. 
 Treat this as “just a job.” This is a foundational role, setting you up for a successful long term career in sales. 
 
 We’re Looking For People Who: 
 ✅ Have 0-2 years of professional sales experience, excluding projects, internships, coursework, bootcamps  ✅ Are eager to grow long-term within a sales path–if your focus is split between sales and other paths like customer success, marketing, operations, etc, this role likely won’t be the best fit. ✅ Are resilient, coachable, and crave feedback to improve. ✅ Are curious and ask why, not just how. ✅ Set high standards for themselves — and hit them. ✅ Are technologically fluent, adapting to new technologies and leveraging AI in your day-to-day. ✅ Communicate clearly, write thoughtfully, and can confidently conduct a cold call. ✅ Are energized by a fast-paced environment and a bit of friendly competition. ✅ Either have past sales success or have demonstrated excellence in goal-driven roles (think: fundraising, athletics, service industry, etc). 
   
 Tools We Use (and You’ll Learn): 
 
 HubSpot (of course)! 
 LinkedIn Sales Navigator 
 AI Powered Tools across all aspects of the role for research & outreach 
 Slack, Zoom, LeadIQ, Google Suite, Zoominfo, and more 
 
 To Apply: 📝 No cover letter required. 📄 Submit your resume. 👉 If you're new to sales, show us your grit: include examples of how you've hit ambitious goals in other roles. 📊 If you’ve been in sales before, highlight metrics like quota attainment. 
 Please Review: Important Information about the Program 
 Bottom Line: We’re looking for future stars, not just seat-fillers. If you want to grow into an elite sales professional and are ready to work hard, get uncomfortable, and see what you're really capable of — this is your shot. 
 Pay & Benefits 
 The cash compensation below includes base salary, on-target commission for employees in eligible roles, and annual bonus targets under HubSpot’s bonus plan for eligible roles. In addition to cash compensation, some roles are eligible to participate in HubSpot’s equity plan to receive restricted stock units (RSUs). Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay. Individual compensation packages are tailored to your skills, experience, qualifications, and other job-related reasons. 
 This resource will help guide how we recommend thinking about the range you see. Learn more about HubSpot’s compensation philosophy . 
 Benefits are also an important piece of your total compensation package. Explore the benefits and perks HubSpot offers to help employees grow better. 
 At HubSpot, fair compensation practices aren’t just about checking off the box for legal compliance. It’s about living out our value of transparency with our employees, candidates, and community. Annual Cash Compensation Range: $53,800 — $90,000 USD 
 At HubSpot, we value both flexibility and connection. Whether you’re a Remote employee or work from the Office, we want you to start your journey here by building strong connections with your team and peers. If you are joining our Engineering team, you will be required to attend a regional HubSpot office for in-person onboarding. If you join our broader Product team, you’ll also attend other in-person events, such as your Product Group Summit and other gatherings, to continue building on those connections. 
 If you require an accommodation due to travel limitations or other reasons, please inform your recruiter during the hiring process. We are committed to supporting candidates who may need alternative arrangements 
 
 About HubSpot 
 HubSpot (NYSE: HUBS) is an AI-powered customer platform with all the software, integrations, and resources customers need to connect marketing, sales, and service. HubSpot's connected platform enables businesses to grow faster by focusing on what matters most: customers.  
 At HubSpot, bold is our baseline. Our employees around the globe move fast, stay customer-obsessed, and win together. Our culture is grounded in four commitments: Solve for the Customer, Be Bold, Learn Fast, Align, Adapt & Go!, and Deliver with HEART. These commitments shape how we work, lead, and grow. 
 We’re building a company where people can do their best work . We focus on brilliant work, not badge swipes. By combining clarity, ownership, and trust, we create space for big thinking and meaningful progress. And we know that when our employees grow, our customers do too. 
 Recognized globally for our award-winning culture by Comparably, Glassdoor, Fortune, and more, HubSpot is headquartered in Cambridge, MA, with employees and offices around the world. 
 Explore more: 
 
 HubSpot Careers 
 Life at HubSpot on Instagram

jobs.title: Business Development Representative - Retail
jobs.excerpt:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy. 
 After years of building an innovative POS platform for restaurateurs, Toast is expanding its offerings into other food and beverage concepts such as convenience stores, grocery stores, and bottle shops. This role will require a founder’s mindset as we grow Toast’s presence in this new vertical with a new offering: the Toast Retail platform. 
 As a Retail Business Development Representative (BDR), you will be part of a founding team that is transforming the way Retailers operate. You will serve as the critical first step in our sales pipeline, responsible for building and qualifying the opportunities that drive our growth.  
 A day in the life (Responsibilities)  
 
 Generate lists of prospective convenience stores, grocery stores, bottle shops, and other retailers to target.  Execute high-volume outreach to a mix of prospective businesses to determine mutual fit. Complete 80 activities daily (cold calls).  
 Conduct qualification calls to develop an understanding of the prospect’s needs and determine how they can benefit from leveraging our Retail solution. 
 Schedule meetings with qualified prospects for Account Executives, ensuring a seamless handoff and a smooth sales process.  
 Partner with Account Executives on strategy, talk tracks, and feedback.  
 Leverage Salesforce (our CRM) to manage all sales activities.  
 Understand the competitive landscape and determine how to best position Toast in the market. 
 
 What you'll need to thrive (Requirements) 
 
 Career Progression: Must be driven by a long-term goal of becoming a full-cycle Account Executive (AE) and working in a commissioned closing role. 
 Proven Drive and Refusal to Fail: Possesses the self-discipline and sustained effort necessary to achieve ambitious daily activity goals and recover quickly from rejection. 
 Growth Mindset: Actively seeks and immediately applies feedback, while proactively self-assessing performance to identify and vocalize specific areas for growth and development. 
 High Self-Accountability: Driven by measurable results and takes full ownership of daily performance metrics and pipeline contribution. 
 High Customer Empathy and Resilience: Demonstrated ability to handle rejection and objections with professionalism while driving positive outcomes for prospective customers. 
 Aptitude for Critical Thinking: Naturally curious, resourceful, and thrives on quickly processing new information to solve complex problems and qualify prospective customers. 
 Exceptional Communication Skills: Clear, professional, and persuasive communicator across high-volume calls and written outreach (email/social). 
 Strong Organizational Skills: Meticulous attention to detail and ability to manage time effectively to balance 80+ daily outreach activities. 
 
 AI at Toast 
 At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture. 
 Our Total Rewards Philosophy  
 We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at  https://careers.toasttab.com/toast-benefits . 
 #LI-DNI The estimated Total Targeted Cash compensation range for this role is listed below. Total Targeted Cash for this role includes base salary, commission, and bonus (if eligible). This role qualifies for uncapped commissions. The starting salary will be determined based on skills, experience, and geographic location.  In addition to cash compensation, our total rewards components include benefits and equity (if eligible). Total Targeted Cash $84,500 — $84,500 USD How Toast Uses AI in its Hiring Process 
 Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more: https://careers.toasttab.com/ai-in-hiring 
 Our Approach to Hybrid Working We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region:  https://careers.toasttab.com/locations-toast 
 People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success 
 At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient—when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry brings together people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we value that same breadth at Toast. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work—raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other. 
 Apply today!

The Core Selling Partner Experience team defines, implements, and enforces quality standards for all Amazon-built experiences for all of our selling partners worldwide. We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst (BA) to join our Governance team, which is focused on measuring the quality of the Selling Partner Experience. This position requires innovative thinking, ability to quickly approach large ambiguous problems and apply reason, technical and engineering expertise to rapidly research, validate, visualize, prototype and deliver solutions. This position also requires significant cross functional work and integration with other teams. Successful candidates should thrive in a collaborative environment. We're looking for someone who is willing to grow with the organization, take ownership and responsibility for the data, to understand it, deep dive problems and own the solution (which often requires partnering with others on and off our team). Key job responsibilities To support this vision, we are seeking a Business Analyst to build analytical tools that will ultimately be a key driver in driving the growth of the company. You will leverage our data to drive operational efficiencies, provide key data-driven insights, enable new opportunities and innovate on behalf of Selling Partners. You will drive future solutions that will impact how we capture sentiment for new Selling Partners and delight our existing ones, and you'll have a lot of fun along the way! As you further your career as a Business Analyst at Amazon, you will focus on improving corporate reporting frameworks and data visualization. You will research performance data, discover and solve real world problems and build metrics and business cases to make strategic business recommendations. We are focused on your success and want to build and support passionate innovators within Selling Partner Services. • Own the design, development, and maintenance of ongoing metrics, reports, analyses, dashboards, etc. • Partner with operations/business teams to consult, develop and implement KPI’s, automated reporting/process solutions, and process improvements to meet business needs. • Enable effective decision making by retrieving and aggregating data from multiple sources and compiling it into a digestible and actionable format. • Prepare and deliver business requirements reviews to the senior management team regarding progress and roadblocks. • Participate in strategic and tactical planning discussions. jobs.title: Associate Product Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt:
About Starburst 
 Starburst delivers enterprise intelligence at scale by giving organizations secure, governed access to all their data, wherever it lives. Built for distributed data environments, Starburst helps enterprises power AI and analytics without the cost and complexity of traditional data consolidation. With open standards including Trino and Apache Iceberg, Starburst enables trusted access to complete enterprise context while helping organizations avoid vendor lock-in. Leading global enterprises trust Starburst to fuel AI, analytics, and enterprise intelligence. Learn more at starburst.ai . About the role 
 Building a great product is not the same as successfully bringing it to market. Every roadmap conversation, launch, webpage, sales deck, and customer evaluation is an opportunity to tell a clear, consistent story. 
 We’re seeking an Associate Product Marketing Manager to help make Starburst easier to understand, buy, and sell. You will translate technical product capabilities into clear customer value, bring new products and features to market, and connect what we build to the revenue plays that help customers discover, evaluate, and purchase Starburst. 
 This role reports to the Head of Product Marketing within the Product organization. You will work closely with Product Managers and Engineering while collaborating across Marketing and GTM—including content, demand generation, Sales Development Representatives, Account Executives, Solution Architects, RevOps, and enablement. 
 We are building a small, high-impact Product Marketing function, so this is a hands-on builder role. Every PMM must be able to connect product, launch, marketing, and field execution, although successful candidates may bring deeper experience in either product and launches or GTM and sales plays. 
 As an Associate Product Marketing Manager at Starburst, you will: 
 
 Develop clear messaging and positioning grounded in the customer problem, the value Starburst provides, and what makes our approach different 
 Translate complex data and AI infrastructure into simple, credible stories for technical buyers, business stakeholders, sellers, and partners 
 Partner with Product Managers early in the development process to build market and customer understanding into roadmap, launch, and go-to-market decisions 
 Own product launches from strategy through execution, including target audience, launch tier, core message, customer-facing assets, internal readiness, distribution, and follow-up 
 Build the materials customers need to evaluate Starburst, including architectural narratives, demos, proof points, competitive guidance, trial and POC support, documentation inputs, and analyst materials 
 Develop revenue plays that connect customer pain to groups of Starburst capabilities, then equip Marketing and the field to execute them consistently 
 Create practical seller enablement for AEs, SDRs, and Solution Architects, including playbooks, pitch materials, competitive guidance, discovery questions, and objection handling 
 Gather customer, buyer, competitive, and field intelligence through interviews, win/loss analysis, seller engagement, and direct customer conversations 
 Measure impact using product adoption, launch engagement, pipeline, revenue-play performance, and qualitative field and customer evidence 
 Help establish the operating system for a growing Product Marketing function, including reusable messaging, launch processes, templates, planning cadences, and feedback loops 
 Use AI to accelerate research and execution while maintaining human judgment and accountability for everything that ships 
 
 Some of the things we look for: 
 
 Approximately 3–5 years of experience in product marketing, product, data or business analysis, solutions consulting, sales enablement, GTM strategy, or another relevant role; prior Product Marketing experience is welcome but not required 
 The ability to understand a technical product and explain its value in concise, customer-friendly language 
 Strong writing, synthesis, presentation, and storytelling skills 
 A bias toward execution: you prioritize useful customer-facing work, move quickly through ambiguity, and improve what you ship using market feedback 
 Commercial judgment and an interest in connecting product investments to customer adoption, pipeline, and revenue 
 The curiosity and technical aptitude to develop fluency in modern data platforms, analytics, AI infrastructure, and the competitive landscape 
 Strong cross-functional relationship skills and the confidence to work directly with Product Managers, engineers, marketers, executives, sellers, and customers 
 A willingness to seek out real customer and field evidence rather than relying exclusively on internal assumptions 
 Ability to travel: This role will require up to 25% in-person travel for new-hire onboarding, team and company offsites, customer engagements, field events, and other business needs 
 
 Nice to have: 
 Strong candidates may bring deeper experience in one of the following areas. We do not expect applicants to have everything listed below. 
 Product and launches 
 
 Experience as a data engineer, BI or data analyst, solutions engineer, technical marketer, or PMM for a technical infrastructure product 
 Familiarity with SQL, data platforms, lakehouses, federated query, Trino, Apache Iceberg, cloud data warehouses, or enterprise AI 
 Experience translating roadmaps into differentiated positioning and executing launches that drive evaluation and adoption 
 Comfort working closely with Product and Engineering teams on technically detailed subject matter 
 
 GTM and sales plays 
 
 Experience in product marketing, GTM strategy, sales enablement, campaign strategy, revenue programs, or customer and market research 
 Experience building plays that align product capabilities, marketing campaigns, seller activity, and measurable revenue outcomes 
 Familiarity with buyer research, win/loss analysis, competitive intelligence, seller interviews, or pipeline analysis 
 Experience working directly with AEs, SDRs, Solution Architects, RevOps, or demand generation teams 
 Starburst is dedicated to maintaining fair and equitable compensation practices. The salary range provided for this role reflects the minimum and maximum targets for candidates across all U.S. locations and could be inclusive of variable compensation, such as commission or bonus. All employees receive equity packages (ISOs) and have access to a comprehensive benefits offering. Actual compensation packages are determined based on relevant skills, experience, education and training, and specific work location. For more information, connect with the recruiting team or Hiring Manager during the process as they can provide more detailed information about the salary range. Pay Range $107,000 — $137,000 USD Build your career at Starburst 
 All-Stars have the opportunity and freedom to realize their true potential. By building alongside top talent, we’re empowered to take ownership of our careers and drive meaningful change. Anchored in industry-proven technology and unprecedented success, All-Stars are taking on the challenge everyday to disrupt our industry –  and the future.  
 Our global workforce is supported by a competitive Total Rewards program that reflects our commitment to a rewarding and supportive work environment. This includes a variety of benefits like competitive pay, attractive stock grants, flexible paid time off, and more.  
 We are committed to fostering an intentional, inclusive, and diverse culture that drives deep engagement, authentic belonging, and an exceptional All-Star experience. We believe that diversity of thought, perspective, background and experience will enable us to own what we do, drive our success and empower our All-Stars to show up authentically.

jobs.excerpt:
About Hightouch 
 Hightouch is an Agentic Marketing Platform powered by the industry-leading Composable CDP. With complete brand context, customer data, and performance history in one place, every marketer finally has the power to build and ship end-to-end campaigns themselves. Teams move faster, stay on brand, and get AI marketing that actually works. 
 Founded in 2019 and headquartered in San Francisco, Hightouch enables marketing teams to analyze performance, brainstorm ideas, and generate creative at a speed and quality that wasn't previously possible. 
 Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Customer Data Platforms, Hightouch is trusted by leading enterprises like Domino's, Spotify, Aritzia, Cars.com, Ramp, and PetSmart. 
 At Hightouch, our mission is to help our customers leverage data and AI to grow their businesses. The team is ambitious, impact-driven, efficient — and we believe humility, kindness, and compassion are essential to our success. If you're energized by velocity, obsessed with raising the bar, and want to build alongside people who care deeply about each other and our customers, we'd love to meet you. About the Role 
 Looking for a role where you can build something from scratch instead of inheriting someone else's playbook? We're hiring our first Competitive Intelligence Manager to own the competitive program end to end. You'll keep our field teams sharp with real-time intel, run sales enablement that reps actually use, feed competitive signals into product and roadmap decisions, and shape campaigns that make it obvious why we win. 
 As our Competitive Intelligence Lead, you'll work closely with Product Marketing, Sales, and Product Management to keep us ahead of the market. If you like owning a function nobody's built yet, turning scattered competitor noise into a clear point of view, and being the person sales calls before a big deal, this is your role. 
 What You’ll Do 
 
 Create and define differentiating positioning for our products and solutions for our various personas (ex: marketing teams, product teams, data teams etc) 
 Run point on cross-functional launches and campaigns across marketing, sales, and product 
 Conduct user research to identify gaps in the market for our product to fill 
 Create, maintain, and improve website messaging, customer case studies, and sales enablement materials 
 Help internal teams and product evangelists craft messaging and sequences that align with customer value 
 Externally evangelize Hightouch at field events, customer engagements, and webinars 
 
 What We’re Looking For 
 
 4-6 years in competitive intelligence, product marketing, or market research, ideally in B2B SaaS 
 Strong primary and secondary research skills (win/loss interviews, analyst reports, public filings, review sites, pricing pages); ability to synthesize messy, conflicting signals into a clear point of view; comfortable building and maintaining structured frameworks (battlecards, comparison matrices, positioning maps). 
 Proven track record of producing content that sales and marketing actually use — battlecards, competitive decks, objection handling guides 
 Storytelling: Proficient in turning complex, technology-heavy topics into digestible, compelling stories that resonate with target audiences 
 Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a talent for crafting clear, persuasive messaging 
 Cross-functional fluency: has worked closely with sales (win/loss, deal support), product (roadmap and positioning input), and marketing (messaging, launches); understands sales cycles well enough to know what reps need in the moment, not just what's "interesting." 
 Domain fit: familiarity with data infrastructure, CDPs, MarTech, or adjacent technical B2B markets. 
 High ownership: flags competitive shifts before sales asks, not just after losing a deal; comfortable being the first person to build this function rather than inheriting an existing playbook. 
 
 Bonus If You Have 
 
 Built or owned a CI program (not just contributed to one) at a prior company; experience in a high-growth or fast-moving market where competitors and positioning shift often. 
 Experience in the CDP, martech, data infrastructure, adtech, AI, or lifecycle marketing ecosystem 
 Startup Experience: Previous experience working in a startup environment, demonstrating the ability to adapt quickly and thrive in a fast-paced setting while wearing many hats. 
 
 The salary range for this position is $135,000 - $165,000 USD per year, which is location-independent in accordance with our remote-first policy. jobs.title: GTM Business Operations Manager
jobs.excerpt:
Who we are 
 Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. 
 Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: 
 Samsara's Go-to-Market Business Operations team is looking for curious, motivated and high-impact professionals to join the team. Our teams’ mandate is to increase revenue growth through the sales performance and efficiency of the Enterprise Sales team. We are a highly collaborative team that partners with sales leaders and cross-functionally to realize growing revenue targets, to scale the organization sustainably, and to address GTM challenges and opportunities.  
 We are a team that seeks to have an outsized impact on Samsara and we achieve that ambition through rigorous and ongoing skill development. 
 This is a remote opportunity open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area. 
 You should apply if:  
 
 You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. 
 You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.  
 You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time. 
 You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.  
 You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focus on winning as a team. 
 
 Click here to learn about what we value at Samsara. 
 In this role, you will:   
 
 Partner with Enterprise Sales Leadership, Sales Planning, Sales Operations, Finance, and other cross-functional teams to provide actionable insights into business drivers, financial performance, and risks. 
 Develop and drive high-visibility initiatives to help scale performance and productivity to achieve sales growth targets. 
 Analyze and diagnose sales team performance and own analytical models and sources of insights (performance forecasting, productivity models, etc). 
 Support ongoing business activities and development of executive materials (memos, slides, business reviews, and executive presentations). 
 Identify risks to growth goals and develop action plans to mitigate those risks. 
 Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices. 
 
 Minimum requirements for the role: 
 
 4-7 years of work experience in a management consulting firm and/or as a Sales Operations / Business Operations or Financial Analyst. 
 Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to independently manage multiple projects on a tight deadline. 
 Ability to communicate effectively orally and in writing. 
 Advanced decision-making, analytical, and logical reasoning skills, including the ability to be proactive and adapt quickly. 
 Kind and collaborative orientation who is energized by working with a lot of different types of people from many teams (sense of humor is a big plus). 
 Deep comfort with analytical tools (e.g., Tableau, Excel, Salesforce, Google Sheets, Databricks) and/or willingness to expand skill set to tackle new problems. 
 Experience working with executives and partnering with cross-functional teams. 
 Comfortable with ambiguity and enthusiastic about improving efficiencies and driving growth. 
 Fully fluent in English. 
 
 An ideal candidate also has: 
 
 Insatiable drive and commitment to personal growth. 
 High level of intellectual curiosity and honesty because we love to debate ideas. Losing a debate to a good argument is as exciting as winning one with a good argument. 
 Familiarity with the evolving AI tool environment, and a curiosity to experiment on how to leverage AI to solve problems. 
 
   The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below. Annual Base Salary $106,802.50 — $161,550 USD Total Rewards 
 At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. 
 Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. 
 Flexible Working  
 At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. 
 Belonging at Samsara 
 At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

jobs.title: Partner Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt:
Who we are  
 At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to  hundreds of thousands of businesses  and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences. 
 Our dedication to remote-first work , and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands. . 
 Hiring and how we work 
 We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!  
 Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.  . See yourself at Twilio 
 Join the team as Twilio’s next Partner Marketing Manager. 
 About the job 
 This position is needed to help scale our partner ecosystem and drive pipeline growth. In this role you will build, execute, and measure co-marketing campaigns. 
 This is the perfect role for a marketer with 4–6 years of experience who understands the fundamentals of B2B marketing and channel dynamics, and is ready to take full ownership of partner-facing initiatives. If you are a strong project manager, a collaborative relationship-builder, and data-driven, you will thrive in this role. 
 Responsibilities 
 In this role, you’ll: 
 
 Co-Marketing & Campaign Development 
 
 Full-Funnel Campaign Development: Work collaboratively to create  campaigns that touch all stages of the buyer’s journey, from awareness to conversion, including joint webinars, customer events, co-created content, etc.. 
 Email Nurture Programs: Design, build, and optimize post-event and post-campaign email nurture programs to execute a comprehensive, multi-touch engagement strategy. 
 Customer Success Stories: Co-author customer success stories featuring strategic partners for both external marketing promotion and internal sales enablement. 
 Tri-Party Plays: Support the development of bundled technology playbooks and build robust, market-ready use cases. 

 Partner Comms Support 
 
 Joint PR and Thought Leadership: Help define and implement joint PR, whitepapers, and thought leadership pieces to elevate our shared brand presence. 
 Own and manage the Twilio Partner Social Media Strategy in alignment with Twilio Corporate plans 

 Partner Campaign & Program Coordination and Management 
 
 Partner-Led Events: Support the execution of partner-hosted campaigns: webinars, regional field events with partners, and customer workshops, including content alignment. 
 Industry Conference Program Support: Assist in coordinating our co-presence with partners at major industry trade shows, managing joint booth presence, logistics, and ancillary partner networking events with customers. 

 Qualifications  
 Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table! 
 *Required: 
 
 Experience: 4–6+ years of experience in Partner Marketing, Channel Marketing, or B2B Demand Generation within the B2B tech/SaaS space. 
 Marketing Fundamentals: Solid understanding of multi-channel demand generation, event execution, and content marketing. 
 Tool Stack: Hands-on experience with Salesforce (SFDC) and marketing automation platforms (e.g., HubSpot, Marketo) is highly preferred. 
 Budgeting Skills: Experience managing or assisting with MDF (Market Development Funds) and budget tracking. 
 Project Management: Exceptional organizational skills with a proven ability to juggle multiple campaigns, events, and partner deadlines simultaneously.
