jobs.excerpt:
Employee Applicant Privacy Notice 
 Who we are: 
 
 Shape a brighter financial future with us. 
 Together with our members, we’re changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance. 
 We’re a next-generation financial services company and national bank using innovative, mobile-first technology to help our millions of members reach their goals. The industry is going through an unprecedented transformation, and we’re at the forefront. We’re proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people’s lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world. 
 The role 
 We're seeking an analytical, execution-oriented Product Marketing Manager to drive engagement and retention marketing for SoFi Checking and Savings, the foundation of our deposits business and our largest driver of member growth. This role focuses on our existing member base: deepening the relationships we already have, growing and retaining balances and direct deposits, and bringing dormant accounts back to life. 
 Your core KPIs will be deposits and direct deposits, with a specific focus on growing and retaining balances across our existing member base. You'll own the promotions and offers that ladder to those goals, working directly with the technical teams that build and implement them. You'll work alongside our Lifecycle Marketing team on engagement and retention campaigns, and partner closely with product and engineering on product-led experiments that turn accounts into everyday banking habits. This includes driving ongoing account utilization as well as reducing churn and reactivating dormant members. 
 Analytical rigor is central to this role. Segmentation, audience development, and offer testing are primary levers for driving deposit and direct deposit growth, and we're looking for someone with the quantitative depth to identify opportunities within the member base and the judgment to prioritize the ones worth pursuing. 
 This is a hands-on individual contributor role with a meaningful piece of the business to drive. You'll be the day-to-day marketing owner of this segment of our business, working in close partnership with the Product Marketing lead for Checking & Savings. You'll collaborate with product, engineering, data science, lifecycle, channel owners, our in-house creative studio, finance, and compliance. 
 What you’ll do: 
 
 Drive day-to-day engagement and retention marketing for Checking & Savings, with core KPIs on deposits and direct deposits across our existing member base 
 Grow and retain balances and direct deposit relationships by identifying the highest-leverage member segments, sizing the opportunity, and building the plan to move them 
 Own the promotions, sweepstakes, and offers tied to your KPIs, from offer construction and setup through launch, compliance review, and post-campaign analysis, working directly with the technical teams that build and implement them 
 Develop sophisticated segmentation and testing programs, designing audience and offer tests that identify and unlock incremental value across the member base 
 Partner closely with Lifecycle Marketing to design, launch, and optimize engagement and retention campaigns across email, push, in-app, and other owned channels 
 Work with product and engineering on product-led experiments: in-product prompts, feature surfacing, and flows that drive direct deposit and balance growth among established members 
 Reduce churn and reactivate dormant members through member segmentation, targeted offers, and disciplined testing 
 Build the measurement plan and own the readout: define success up front, read results with an eye toward incrementality, and turn findings into concrete recommendations for the next cycle 
 
 What you’ll need: 
 
 4+ years of product marketing, growth marketing, lifecycle marketing, or closely related experience, preferably in fintech, banking, or another regulated consumer category 
 Analytical Thinking: Strong quantitative skills and comfort in spreadsheets and Business Intelligence tools. You can build a segmentation, run a cohort or retention analysis, size an opportunity, read a test result, and clearly explain what happened and why 
 Strategic Thinking: Ability to connect day-to-day execution to business outcomes, prioritize where it matters, and make a reasoned case for a recommendation 
 Cross-Functional Collaboration: Proven experience working closely with cross-functional teams, especially Product and technical/engineering partners. You can translate marketing needs into requirements a technical team can build against 
 Experimentation: Experience designing and running tests in campaigns, in product, or both and distilling results into insights others can act on 
 Project Management: Ability to manage multiple concurrent campaigns, dependencies, and deadlines without losing the details 
 Communication: Write clearly and concisely; can brief a creative team and present a readout to partners with equal ease 
 Initiative & Bias for Action: Eagerness to roll up your sleeves to get things done (even the unglamorous things) 
 Bachelor's degree required 
 
 Nice to have: 
 
 Experience marketing banking or deposit products, particularly around direct deposit or balance growth 
 Experience with segmentation and audience targeting against a large customer base 
 Experience building and running promotions, sweepstakes, or offer and bonus mechanics 
 Working familiarity with SQL and Business Intelligence tools such as Tableau 
 Experience operating in a regulated environment alongside legal and compliance partners 
 Compensation and Benefits 
 The base pay range for this role is listed below. Final base pay offer will be determined based on individual factors such as the candidate’s experience, skills, and location.  
   
 To view all of our comprehensive and competitive benefits, visit our  Benefits at SoFi   page! 
 SoFi provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion (including religious dress and grooming practices), sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions, breastfeeding, and conditions related to breastfeeding), gender, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, age (40 or over), physical or medical disability, medical condition, marital status, registered domestic partner status, sexual orientation, genetic information, military and/or veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by applicable state or federal law. 
 The Company hires the best qualified candidate for the job, without regard to protected characteristics. 
 Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. 
 New York applicants: Notice of Employee Rights 
 SoFi is committed to an inclusive culture. As part of this commitment, SoFi offers reasonable accommodations to candidates with physical or mental disabilities. If you need accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, please let your recruiter know or email accommodations@sofi.com. 
 We are unable to accommodate remote work from Hawaii, Alaska or Puerto Rico at this time. 
 Internal Employees 
 If you are a current employee, do not apply here - please navigate to our Internal Job Board in Greenhouse to apply to our open roles.

jobs.excerpt:
Who we are 
 Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. 
 Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: 
 Interested in joining a top-notch marketing team? We are looking for an energetic, highly organized, team player who loves a fast-paced environment and thrives on results. In this role, you will meticulously plan, execute & measure new events and programs for Samsara. These events can include industry trade shows, hosted events, customer and executive experiences, regional summits, educational programs and workshops, strategic sponsorships, partner activations, and other high-impact field marketing programs. 
 This is a highly cross-functional role that requires close partnership across Sales, Account Development, Product Marketing, Marketing Operations & Product Management. You should be results-driven, detail-oriented, and passionate about driving business impact. This is a fast-growing area of the business that plays a strategic role in our future success. 
 This is a remote role open to candidates based in Mexico City and will require travel up to 50% in Mexico. 
 You should apply if: 
 
 You want to impact the industries that run our world:  Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. 
 You are the architect of your own career:  If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment. 
 You’re energized by our opportunity:  The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers. 
 You want to be with the best:  At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.  
 
 In this role, you will:  
 
 Own trade shows and hosted events strategy, planning, execution, and success for a strategic company industry vertical, territory or segment 
 Execute end-to-end event program management and logistics from initial planning to post-event program follow up, including vendor management, budget management, event promotions, sales enablement, data cleansing/tracking, KPI measurement, and maintenance of all event assets 
 Manage event budget forecast and reporting, evaluate and communicate results against goals, and generate learnings for improvement 
 Facilitate timely event lead processing within Salesforce, measure event impact, and develop post-event reports and communicate insights 
 Own project management tools, documentation, event calendar, and processes used for managing event marketing programs & tradeshows 
 Bring energy, creativity, and new ideas to build a successful event program 
 Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices 
 
 Minimum requirements for the role: 
 
 3+ years of professional experience in field marketing, event marketing, or integrated marketing, with demonstrated ownership of customer-facing programs from strategy and planning through execution and post-event measurement. 
 Proven ability to manage multiple programs simultaneously in a fast-paced environment, navigate shifting priorities, and consistently deliver against deadlines without compromising execution quality. 
 Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with demonstrated experience partnering closely with Sales, Marketing, Operations, Product Marketing, agencies, vendors, and other internal and external stakeholders. 
 Excellent project management and organizational skills, with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to build scalable processes, documentation, timelines, and operational frameworks. 
 Proficient using a CRM (e.g., Salesforce) and/or Marketing Automation platforms. 
 Must be fluent in Spanish and English. 
 Based in/near Mexico City and comfortable going into the office when needed. 
 Ability to travel up to 50% for events. 
 
 An ideal candidate also has: 
 
 A positive attitude, a team player mentality, and an unmatched love and enthusiasm for all things events. 
 A demand generation mindset for event assessment, planning, and execution. 
 Experience communicating with and presenting to senior executives, VIPs, customers, and partners. 
 Experience managing strategic partnerships, sponsorships, and third-party event relationships to maximize brand presence and business impact. 
 Outstanding skills in problem-solving, project management, creative thinking, written/verbal communication, and presenting. 
 A self-starter mentality with impeccable organization and a strong attention to detail. 
 The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below. Annual Base Salary $569,075 — $669,500 MXN Total Rewards 
 At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. 
 Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. 
 Flexible Working  
 At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. The GTM Operations Associate - Channels & Alliances will join a global team driving Datadog's next phase of growth. We are interdisciplinary thinkers with diverse backgrounds across consulting, finance, strategy, operations, and technology. Our team partners directly with GTM leaders to improve operational efficiency, support data-driven decision-making, and scale the processes and systems that enable continued growth. 
 In this role, you will serve as an operational partner to Datadog's Channels & Alliances organization. You will execute critical business operations, support reporting and business systems, and help scale operational processes across the organization. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure our C&A teams have the tools, data, and operational support they need to be successful. Success in this role requires strong attention to detail, systems thinking, and a passion for improving how teams operate. 
 At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them. 
 What you'll do: 
 
 Own recurring operational processes that support the global Channels & Alliances organization, ensuring execution is timely, accurate, and scalable. 
 Build, maintain, and enhance Salesforce reports and dashboards to provide visibility into pipeline, partner performance, and other key business metrics. 
 Partner with C&A, Revenue Operations, Systems, Sales, and other cross-functional teams to improve operational workflows, resolve business issues, and ensure data integrity across systems. 
 Coordinate with and evaluate external vendors to support operational processes, systems enhancements, and business initiatives. 
 Create and maintain process documentation, playbooks, and standard operating procedures to improve consistency and scalability across the organization. 
 Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and leverage AI-enabled tools to improve operational efficiency and reduce administrative work. 
 Serve as a trusted operational resource for the Channels & Alliances organization, balancing multiple priorities while delivering high-quality support to stakeholders across the business. 
 
 Who you are: 
 
 Bachelor's degree.

 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present to audiences large and small and create clear, compelling content—from concise partner communications to detailed launch plans and thought leadership. 
 Ability to synthesize complex information into clear, customer- and partner-centric messaging for different audiences. 
 Experience with AI tools (e.g., Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, Gemini, etc.) 
 Strong cross-functional project and program management skills, including the ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager, Web & Search
jobs.excerpt:
About Decagon

Decagon is the leading conversational AI platform empowering every brand to deliver concierge customer experiences.

Our technology enables industry-defining enterprises like Avis Budget Group, Block’s Cash App and Square, Chime, Oura Health, and Hunter Douglas to deploy AI agents that power personalized, deeply satisfying interactions across voice, chat, email, SMS, and every other channel.

We’re building a future where customer experiences are being redefined from support tickets and hold music to faster resolutions, richer conversations, and deeper relationships. We’re proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including a16z, Accel, Bain Capital Ventures, Coatue, and Index Ventures, along with many others.

We’re an in-office company, driven by a shared commitment to excellence and velocity. Our values — Just Get It Done, Invent What Customers Want, Winner’s Mindset, and The Polymath Principle — shape how we work and grow as a team.

About the Role
We're looking for a Growth Marketing Manager to own the day-to-day of our website and drive our SEO and AEO strategy. You'll be the person who actually ships what's on the roadmap, new pages, localization work, ongoing site changes, while also owning how we show up in traditional and AI-driven search, from strategy through execution.

In this role, you will

 - Run website execution day-to-day, and build the systems to move faster: Project manage and execute against the website roadmap, launching new pages, making ongoing site changes, while also building or improving the workflows and tooling that let publishing move faster, removing manual bottlenecks wherever possible.

 - Own and execute SEO and AEO strategy: Set the strategy for how Decagon shows up in both traditional search and AI-driven search surfaces (ChatGPT, Perplexity, and similar), including exploring programmatic approaches to scale beyond manual content production, and do the hands-on work to make it happen, not just goals and measurement, but the actual execution. This includes managing a content contractor and working with our internal team to keep production moving.

 - Help make our site scalable as we expand internationally: Own website localization work as we grow into new markets, and keep things like cookie consent and privacy policy updated, etc., as part of building a site that can support that growth.

Your background looks something like this

 - Experience owning a company website day-to-day. Comfortable in a CMS (we use Webflow), able to ship pages and changes without needing an engineer for every task.

 - Ideally has some technical experience: comfortability with HTML/CSS, scripting, or web dev experience, etc.

 - Real SEO and AEO expertise. You can set strategy and execute it yourself, and you're tracking how AI-driven search is changing the discipline.

 - Comfortable with or curious about programmatic approaches to scaling content and search presence, rather than treating growth as one page at a time.

 - Fluent with SEO/AEO tooling: GA4, Search Console, Ahrefs, and comfortable pulling and interpreting your own data.

 - Analytical: you set goals, measure against them, and know how to tell whether SEO/AEO work is actually driving pipeline, not just traffic.

 - Comfortable managing outside help (contractors/freelancers) as well as working closely with an internal team.

Even better if you have

 - Experience with website localization or multi-market SEO (hreflang, localized content strategy).

 - Experience building or working with programmatic SEO/content systems.

 - Familiarity with tools like Clay, Unify, or similar automation platforms.

 - Experience working alongside a more senior technical growth lead or growth engineering function.

Compensation
$160,000 - $200,000 + Equity 

Benefits

We proudly offer the following benefits for our full-time employees:

 - Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family

 - Life Insurance and Disability Benefits

 - Retirement Plan (e.g., 401K, pension)

 - Parental Leave

 - Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

 - Monthly stipend to support your wellness, lifestyle, and work-life balance

 - Daily lunches and snacks in the office to keep you at your best

 - Take what you need vacation policy (subject to local requirements; UK employees receive 25 days of statutory leave)

These benefits are described in more detail in Decagon’s policies, may vary by location, and can change at any time according to applicable compensation and benefits plans.

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt:
About Decagon

Decagon is the leading conversational AI platform empowering every brand to deliver concierge customer experiences.

Our technology enables industry-defining enterprises like Avis Budget Group, Block’s Cash App and Square, Chime, Oura Health, and Hunter Douglas to deploy AI agents that power personalized, deeply satisfying interactions across voice, chat, email, SMS, and every other channel.

We’re building a future where customer experiences are being redefined from support tickets and hold music to faster resolutions, richer conversations, and deeper relationships. We’re proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including a16z, Accel, Bain Capital Ventures, Coatue, and Index Ventures, along with many others.

We’re an in-office company, driven by a shared commitment to excellence and velocity. Our values — Just Get It Done, Invent What Customers Want, Winner’s Mindset, and The Polymath Principle — shape how we work and grow as a team.

About the Role

We’re looking for a field marketing manager to continue to build out our field marketing function across conferences, events, and executive dinners to drive awareness and pipeline generation. You will help shape the strategy and execution from the field marketing program. The ideal candidate has experience running field events at a fast growing B2B SaaS startup.

In this role, you will

 - Partner closely with our GTM leadership team to execute on the right portfolio of events to accelerate demand generation pipelines

 - Execute on our event strategy ensuring we’re getting in front of the right audience, generating leads, and reaching out to leads in a timely manner

 - Extend the Decagon brand across different event formats including conferences, executive dinners, webinars, product launch events, and more

 - Define and measure field marketing success through key performance indicators (KPIs) such as ROI, lead generation, pipeline influence, and sales engagement.

 - Own the outcome of the leads generated and driving high ROI of our events

Your background looks something like this

 - 3-5 years of experience planning and executing and hosting sponsored events

 - 1-2+ years of field marketing experience with a B2B SaaS / enterprise software startup

 - Excellent attention to detail and operational rigor

 - The ability to span events across tradeshows, webinar/virtual, and customer dinners

 - The ability to span events across awareness (building awareness of Decagon’s brand and getting in front of new leads) and demand generation (driving demos booked)

 - Experience and affinity for evolving projects and experiments into repeatable programs

 - Outstanding project management skills, the ability to organize and manage multiple priorities, working relationships, cross-functional partners, and vendors while driving timelines and owning the outcome

 - Familiarity with sales processes and systems

 - The ability to travel domestically and internationally up to 40%

Benefits

We proudly offer the following benefits for our full-time employees:

 - Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family

 - Life Insurance and Disability Benefits

 - Retirement Plan (e.g., 401K, pension)

 - Parental Leave

 - Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

 - Monthly stipend to support your wellness, lifestyle, and work-life balance

 - Daily lunches and snacks in the office to keep you at your best

 - Take what you need vacation policy (subject to local requirements; UK employees receive 25 days of statutory leave)

These benefits are described in more detail in Decagon’s policies, may vary by location, and can change at any time according to applicable compensation and benefits plans.

jobs.excerpt:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.  
 At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.  
 A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone. We're looking for a Manager of Influencer Marketing to build and scale the operational backbone of our global influencer program. This is not a traditional campaign role — you'll be the person who turns creator relationships and regional programs into a repeatable, data-driven machine. You'll own the systems, playbooks, and tools that allow our influencer marketing team to operate efficiently at scale across markets and content types. 
 This role sits at the intersection of marketing strategy and program operations, and is ideal for someone who thinks in systems, loves building things from scratch, and is energized by the challenge of bringing structure to a fast-moving space. 
 You will: 
 Program Operations & Scale 
 
 Design and manage the operational infrastructure for a global influencer program spanning multiple content types, markets, and campaign types 
 Partner with web systems team to manage front-end, creator facing authenticated portal as well as back-end systems 
 Build scalable workflows in our CRM system for influencer sourcing, contracting, onboarding, activation, and reporting — reducing manual lift while increasing output 
 Define and maintain program standards, SLAs, and intake processes across internal stakeholders and external partners 
 Partner with legal, finance, and other internal and external partners to streamline contracting and payment operations globally 
 
 Global Playbooks 
 
 Develop and maintain a suite of global playbooks covering influencer program application management, relationship tiering, campaign briefing, content guidelines, and performance benchmarking 
 Localize frameworks for regional teams while preserving global consistency in brand standards and measurement methodology 
 Establish best practices for new program verticals (e.g., live events, product launches, always-on ambassador programs) and codify learnings into repeatable resources 
 Train and enable cross-functional partners and regional teams on playbook adoption 

 CRM & Tooling 
 
 Lead the buildout of a centralized influencer CRM and creator-facing portal — defining data architecture, contact management standards, tagging taxonomy, and relationship history tracking 
 Build, evaluate, implement, and own influencer marketing technology (CRM platforms, discovery tools, reporting dashboards) and serve as the internal subject matter expert 
 Partner with data and analytics teams to develop dashboards that give real-time visibility into program health, creator performance, and spend efficiency 
 Ensure creator-facing portal is dynamic and up to date with our backend updates, and tooling for influencers adoption and usage. 
 Identify gaps in existing tooling and build or commission solutions that reduce friction and improve team output 

 You have: 
 
 8-10 years of experience in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, or a closely related field, with at least 2 years in a role focused on operations, program management, or marketing technology 
 Exceptional project management skills — highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously in a rapidly changing environment 
 Demonstrated experience building or significantly improving influencer marketing infrastructure — playbooks, workflows, CRM systems, or reporting tools 
 Comfort operating across global markets and working with regional teams to adapt centralized frameworks 
 Strong analytical skills; able to work fluently with data to drive decisions and communicate program performance to leadership 
 Clear, concise communicator who can translate complex operational concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences 
 A bias toward building: you'd rather create a system than patch a problem 
 Experience in gaming, entertainment, or consumer tech — particularly with creator ecosystems tied to UGC or live platforms 
 Familiarity with influencer contract structures, FTC guidelines, and international compliance considerations 
 Background in or exposure to marketing analytics, business intelligence tools, or data pipeline basics 
 Experience supporting large-scale live events or product launches with influencer programming components 
 For roles that are based at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA: The starting base pay for this position is as shown below. The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. Therefore, in some circumstances, the actual salary could fall outside of this expected range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on this page . Annual Salary Range $191,340 — $234,390 USD Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).

Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Manager
jobs.excerpt:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven. About Us 
 Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. 
 Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. 
 As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites. 
 About the Role 
 We're looking for a Marketing Operations Manager on our Marketing Operations team to own lead management and revenue handoff — the routing logic and BDR tooling workflows leads and contacts move through, and the rules that determine how and when marketing hands them to sales. 
 This role owns the scoring and routing logic that runs on our core marketing and sales platforms, plus a set of adjacent lifecycle processes — MQL definitions, SLA design, lead source governance, ABM list management, and partner-sourced lead triage. You'll partner with our Sr. Marketing Operations & Technology Manager, who owns core platform administration, and with Sales/BDR leadership on the day-to-day handoff relationship. 
 This is a full-time, fully remote position based in Costa Rica, with working hours aligned to the Central Time zone to support close, real-time collaboration with our Oakland, CA-based team and US sales organization. 
 Technologies You’ll Use 
 
 Marketo, LeanData, Salesforce, Outreach, Nooks, Clay, etc. 
 
 What You’ll Do 
 Scoring & Routing 
 
 Build, maintain, and calibrate the lead scoring model in Marketo, using BDR feedback and closed-won/lost data to keep it predictive rather than stale 
 Own lead routing logic and governance in LeanData — match rules, ownership logic, and routing paths — in partnership with the Sr. Marketing Operations & Technology Manager on platform administration 
 Own MQL definitions and the marketing-to-sales handoff process, including SLA design and ongoing SLA monitoring 
 
 Lifecycle & Handoff Processes 
 
 Own lead/contact lifecycle status management and lead source governance 
 Own inbound and partner-sourced lead triage/routing processes 
 Manage ABM account list and signal strategy in partnership with enterprise sales stakeholders 
 Optimize BDR tooling workflows across Outreach, Nooks, and Clay — sequence/cadence logic, data flow between tools, and adoption — within the platform and vendor decisions set by Systems and leadership 
 Set and enforce SFDC data entry standards for sales-owned fields relevant to lead/contact records, in partnership with Sales leadership 
 Run a regular Sales & MOps alignment cadence with sales/BDR leadership to review routing and handoff health 
 
 Skills We’re Looking For 
 
 4–6 years of experience in marketing operations, revenue operations, or lifecycle roles in B2B SaaS or high-growth environments 
 Direct, hands-on experience building and calibrating lead scoring models in Marketo 
 Experience owning lead routing logic in LeanData or a comparable platform 
 Working knowledge of SQL sufficient to validate routing and scoring outcomes against CRM data 
 Experience partnering with sales or BDR leadership on lead handoff logic, SLAs, routing rules, and CRM data standards 
 Comfortable working independently across US business hours as part of a distributed team 
 Ability to use conversational AI systems (like Claude, ChatGPT, or internal tools) to support researching, documenting, and troubleshooting scoring and routing logic, and to synthesize funnel/handoff diagnostics 
 
 (Optional )Bonus Skills​ 
 
 Experience working within BDR-facing tools (Outreach, Nooks, Clay, or comparable) to improve workflow efficiency 
 Experience with Bizible/Marketo Measure, Demandbase, or other ABM platforms 
 Prior experience mentoring or supporting more junior marketing operations team members 
 Experience setting or enforcing CRM data governance standards for a sales organization 

 #LI-REMOTE 
 #LI-JC1   
 Perks and Benefits 
 
 100% employer-paid medical insurance * 
 Generous paid time-off policy (PTO), plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave policy, holidays (including a year end Global Week of Rest), and volunteer days off 
 RSU stock grants* 
 Professional development and training opportunities 
 Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities 
 Monthly cell phone stipend 
 Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents. 
 
 * May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information

 We’re honored to be valued at over $5.6 billion , but more importantly, we’re proud of our  core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream . Read about us in  Forbes .      
 Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities.

At Stanley Martin Homes, you will work alongside passionate, knowledgeable professionals who are committed to doing the right thing, delivering exceptional homebuyer experiences, and putting homebuyers first.

The Email Marketing Manager is responsible for developing and executing Stanley Martin Homes' email marketing and lifecycle communications strategy. This role owns the email channel from strategy through execution, leveraging Salesforce Marketing Cloud to deliver personalized, data-driven experiences that drive engagement, lead conversion and business results. The Email Marketing Manager oversees email programs across the customer journey, including lead nurture, re-engagement, transactional communications and post-inquiry follow-up. This role partners closely with Customer Acquisition, Marketing Operations, Marketing Technology, Analytics, Content and Sales to ensure email programs support customer engagement, qualified lead generation and revenue growth.
Build and manage campaigns and automated journeys in Salesforce Marketing Cloud (Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Email Studio, Content Builder, Contact Builder).
Own segmentation and personalization through SQL, AMPscript and dynamic content, and keep audience data clean, compliant and current.

~ Ensure email deliverability, maintain sender reputation, manage authentication protocols, and uphold CAN-SPAM compliance across all email communications.

Measure email's contribution to lead quality, appointments and net contracts — not open rates in isolation — through GA4, Looker and Salesforce, and run a disciplined testing and optimization program.
Manage, coach and develop direct reports while building a high-performing team.

Complete all other duties as assigned by manager.
Ability to translate email marketing performance data into actionable insights and measurable business outcomes through effective use of analytics and attribution.

Bachelor's degree in marketing, business administration, communications or a related field.
~5–7+ years in email marketing, lifecycle marketing or marketing automation, with 3+ years hands-on in Salesforce Marketing Cloud (Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Email Studio, Content Builder).
~ Working command of SQL and AMPscript for segmentation and personalization.

Salesforce Marketing Cloud or other Salesforce certifications, and Data Cloud experience.
GA4, Looker and marketing attribution platforms.
Experience building, scaling or transforming an email marketing function.
Experience evaluating and adopting AI-enabled marketing and personalization tools.
Access to competitively priced, high-quality health care options through Aetna, MetLife and EyeMed, along with employer-paid Short Term and Long Term disability, basic life and AD&D insurance (including employee-paid life, Legal Resources, and Aflac supplemental options)

~ Receive well-rounded wellness benefits, including free and low-cost mental health resources and support services through our Employee Assistance Program
~ Continue your education with tuition and certification reimbursement

~ Receive great discounts on buying a Stanley Martin home and discounts with our partners in mortgage and title services as well as cell phone service through Verizon

jobs.title: Influencer Marketing Specialist
jobs.excerpt:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.  
 At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.  
 A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone. We're looking for an Influencer Marketing Specialist to join our and help bring influencer campaigns to life. This is an execution-focused role built for someone who is highly organized, creator-savvy, and eager to get hands-on experience across all facets of influencer marketing — from day-to-day campaign coordination to supporting live events on the ground. 
 You'll work closely with senior team members to support a roster of creators, keep campaigns running on time, and be a key point of contact for influencers throughout their partnership journey. If you love being in the mix, thrive in fast-paced environments, and take pride in getting the details right, this role is for you. 
 You will : 
 Campaign Support 
 
 Assist in the end-to-end execution of influencer campaigns — supporting briefing, content review, posting coordination, and performance tracking 
 Manage campaign timelines and deliverable trackers, flagging risks and keeping all parties aligned 
 Partner with internal teams to draft creator briefs, talking points, and campaign recaps under the direction of senior team members 
 Coordinate with internal teams (creative, legal, social, events) to ensure influencer content is on-brand and delivered on schedule 
 Pull and compile performance data from influencer platforms and internal dashboards to support weekly and campaign-level reporting 
 
 Event Support 
 
 Serve as an on-the-ground point of contact for influencers at live events — managing logistics, schedules, and real-time needs 
 Help coordinate influencer travel, accommodations, and event-day itineraries in partnership with the events and operations teams 
 Support event activations from pre-production through wrap, ensuring creator experience is smooth and on-brand 
 Assist in capturing content moments and documentation at events for post-event recaps and learnings 
 
 Relationship Management 
 
 Act as a day-to-day contact for a defined roster of creators and their management teams, building trust and maintaining positive ongoing relationships 
 Track creator deliverables, communicate deadlines, and follow up to keep partnerships on schedule 
 Help onboard new influencers into the program — sending contracts, answering questions, and walking partners through the process 
 Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in the influencer CRM, including contact info, campaign history, and relationship notes 
 Monitor creator content, community sentiment, and platform activity to surface relevant updates to the team 
 
 You have: 
 
 3-4 years of experience in influencer marketing, creator relations, talent management, social media, or a closely related field 
 A genuine understanding of the creator landscape — you follow creators, know the platforms, and can speak fluently about content trends 
 Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously without dropping the ball 
 
 You are: 
 
 Clear, professional communicator — comfortable drafting emails to creators and their reps, and working cross-functionally with internal teams 
 Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift and no two days look the same 
 Detail-oriented and proactive — you spot what needs to happen next and take initiative to make it happen 
 Familiar with influencer platforms, social media analytics tools, or creator CRM systems is a plus 
 
 Nice to Have 
 
 Experience supporting live events or experiential marketing activations 
 Exposure to influencer contracting, gifting programs, or affiliate/commission structures 
 Background in gaming, entertainment, or consumer tech with knowledge of UGC creator communities 
 Proficiency in Google Suite and knowledge of creator focused tools like Tubular, CreatorIQ, etc 
 For roles that are based at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA: The starting base pay for this position is as shown below. The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. Therefore, in some circumstances, the actual salary could fall outside of this expected range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on this page . Annual Salary Range $151,890 — $191,340 USD Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted). 
 Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.

jobs.title: Integrated Marketing & Campaigns
jobs.excerpt:
WE ARE AN APPLIED AI LAB BUILDING END-TO-END SOFTWARE AGENTS.

We're the makers of Devin, the first AI software engineer. 

Our team is extremely talent-dense. Among our founding team, we have world-class competitive programmers, former founders, and leaders from companies at the cutting edge of AI including Scale AI, Palantir, Cursor, Waymo, Tesla, Lunchclub, Modal, Google DeepMind, and Nuro.

Building Devin is just the first step—our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you’re excited to solve some of the world’s biggest problems and build AI that can reason on real-world tasks, apply to join us.

The Role

We’re looking for a hands-on marketer to turn Cognition’s differentiated technology and customer impact into enterprise campaigns that drive pipeline and sales.

You’ll create content and experiences that influence every key stakeholder in an enterprise purchase—from engineering champions and technical evaluators to executive sponsors and economic buyers. Your work will help customers understand what’s possible, evaluate our technology, build the business case, and move confidently toward adoption.

You’ll own campaigns from idea through execution and promotion, bringing together the right message, format, audience, and channels. This role combines strong storytelling, commercial judgment, and the ability to ship quickly.

What You’ll Do

 - Build integrated campaigns around our most important themes. Partner with Product Marketing to translate Cognition’s positioning, key messaging, and differentiation into campaigns that create demand and advance enterprise deals.

 - Create content across the buying journey. Develop ebooks, research, webinars, demo experiences, practical templates and guides, workshops, business-case tools, and other formats that help buyers move from initial interest through evaluation and purchase.

 - Reach the full buying group. Address the distinct priorities of engineering leaders, developers, IT and security stakeholders, and business executives—with the right depth, evidence, and next step for each audience.

 - Make campaigns relevant across verticals. Translate broad themes into industry-specific use cases, challenges, and customer outcomes, partnering with Enterprise Demand and Sales on priority segments and accounts.

 - Own the promotion strategy. Build distribution into every campaign from the start. Coordinate paid, email, web, social, partner, field, and sales activation with the teams responsible for each channel.

 - Bring technical differentiation to life. Work with Product Marketing, engineers, technical experts, and customers to turn complex capabilities into credible stories and demonstrations of enterprise impact.

 - Execute from brief to launch. Own campaign plans, content development, production, timelines, and follow-up. Write and build directly, bringing in internal experts and external resources where needed.

 - Optimize for pipeline and revenue. Partner with Revenue Operations and Sales to measure buying-group engagement, qualified pipeline, opportunity progression, and sales outcomes. Use those insights to improve the next campaign.

What Success Looks Like

Your campaigns consistently reach the right buyers, make Cognition’s differentiation tangible, and help Sales create and win enterprise opportunities. You build a repeatable approach to turning our strongest ideas, product capabilities, and customer evidence into programs that produce measurable commercial results.

You Should Be

 - A track record of building and executing integrated campaigns for enterprise B2B technology buyers.

 - Strong content development and writing skills, with examples of work you personally took from concept to launch.

 - Experience connecting content, distribution, and sales follow-up to measurable pipeline outcomes.

 - An understanding of complex enterprise buying groups and how their information needs change throughout a deal.

 - The ability to move between an executive business narrative and detailed product or use-case content.

 - Strong project ownership: you can coordinate multiple contributors, make decisions, and ship high-quality work quickly.

 - A practical approach to experimentation, including using AI tools to accelerate research, production, and iteration.

Bonus Points

 - Experience marketing developer tools, AI, infrastructure, or other technical enterprise products.

 - Comfort creating technical content and partnering closely with engineers or solutions teams.

 - Experience building vertical campaigns, technical webinars, demo-led programs, or content that supports active enterprise opportunities.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Cognition is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities throughout the hiring process - please let us know if you need any.

 Our People:

We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging.  Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology.  6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers.  We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.  As our Partner Marketing Manager you will be responsible for turning strategic partnerships into a measurable pipeline motion- building the co-marketing programs, and partner activation strategies that help communicate the power of 6Sense alongside our key partners. This is a builder's role for someone who wants to own a meaningful piece of how 6sense grows, and who understands that great partner marketing sits at the intersection of relationship depth and disciplined execution.   
 Responsibilities :   
 
 Joint Go-to-Market Programs Build and run co-marketing programs with strategic partners ,  from end to end: partner alignment, asset development, campaign execution, field activation, and measurement. Own the pipeline contribution from partner marketing activity and be accountable for reporting it clearly.   
 Joint Events and Activations Own the partner presence at key industry events (including our own,  BreakThrough ), co-hosted webinars, and joint field programs. Coordinate  logistics , messaging, and follow-up across both sides of the partnership to make sure activations generate  pipeline .   
 Partner Relationships Serve as the primary marketing counterpart to partner marketing and alliances teams at key accounts. Build the kind of working relationships where partner counterparts are actively seeking  us out. Create  opportunities  for 6sense to  co-present at joint  events, and  develop the trust that makes joint programs move faster.   
 Partner Marketing Metrics Define what success looks like for partner marketing at 6sense,  working with marketing operations to  build the reporting infrastructure to measure it, and communicate results to marketing leadership and BD stakeholders on a regul ar  cade nce .   
 Performance Measurement   
 Partner-Sourced Pipeline Volume and velocity of pipeline generated through co-marketing programs and partner activations, tracked with clear attribution.   
 Partner Marketing Engagement Depth of engagement from partner counterparts: co-investment in programs, co-branded content produced, joint events executed, and partner-sourced leads generated.   
 Enablement Adoption Usage and effectiveness of partner-facing enablement materials, measured by partner sales team feedback and co-sell conversation rates.   
 Program Execution Quality On-time, on-brief delivery of co-marketing programs - with the partner relationship strengthened as a result.   
 
 Competencies and Behaviors:   
 
 Influence Without Authority  Operates effectively in an environment where the people you most depend on (partner counterparts, internal sales, product marketing) don't report into the same leadership. Builds alignment through credibility and relationships.   
 Revenue-First Thinking  Connects every program to pipeline and revenue. Doesn't measure success by content produced or events run. Asks "what did this produce?" and builds programs that are designed to answer that question.   
 Partner-Facing Presence  Comfortable representing 6sense externally. Shows up in partner conversations with enough confidence and preparation to be a genuine asset in the room.   
 Execution Discipline  Manages the complexity of co-marketing at pace. Gets joint programs across the finish line even when approval chains are complex.   
 Cross-Functional Orchestration Works fluidly across product marketing, demand generation, content, field marketing, and BD to bring partner programs to life. 
 
 Educational and Experience Requirements: 
 
 5 or more years in B2B marketing, with at least 2 years in a field marketing role, partner marketing, alliance marketing, or ecosystem marketing role where you owned outcomes and field programs.   
 Experience working directly with external partner stakeholders. You have presented to partner leadership, negotiated co-marketing agreements, and maintained productive relationships through disagreements.   
 A clear point of view on how to measure partner marketing impact, including how to handle the attribution ambiguity that comes with the territory.   
 Familiarity with the B2B SaaS technology ecosystem: how ISV partnerships, technology integrations, and co-sell motions work in practice.

jobs.excerpt:
Join us in building the future of finance. 
 Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role 
 We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 
 The Business Analyst team shapes the strategy, growth, and performance of Robinhood's credit products, delivering top-tier experiences for our users. As part of the broader Credit organization, we work closely with product, engineering, risk, and operations to unlock sustainable business growth through deep analytical rigor. Our team fosters a collaborative, ownership-driven culture where every analyst directly influences business strategy and product direction. 
 As a Business Analyst, you'll be part of an 18-month rotational program, completing approximately five rotations across different areas of our Money and Growth org. Each rotation embeds you alongside product, engineering, risk, and operations teams — giving you direct exposure to the metrics, stakeholders, and strategic priorities that drive Robinhood's core business. You'll own real work from day one, build cross-functional fluency fast, and leave each rotation having made a measurable impact. 
 This role is based in our Washington, D.C. office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. 
 At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 
 What you’ll do 
 
 Build fluency across the Money and Growth org by rotating through roughly 5 distinct team assignments over the program, each with its own stakeholders, metrics, and strategic priorities 
 Analyze business performance metrics and economic drivers to identify growth opportunities and optimize business outcomes 
 Structure and solve complex, ambiguous problems across product strategy, pricing, user segmentation, and risk-return trade-offs 
 Partner with engineering, product, risk, and finance teams to execute key strategic initiatives and monitor program efficacy 
 Develop analytical models, dashboards, and executive-level presentations to inform leadership decision-making and influence core business direction 
 
 What you bring 
 
 Experience in business analysis, strategy, management consulting, financial services, or a quantitative analytical role 
 Strong proficiency in SQL and advanced quantitative modeling techniques 
 Ability to synthesize complex quantitative findings into clear, actionable recommendations for cross-functional partners 
 Fluency with AI tools, with a genuine interest in staying current as the tools evolve 
 Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Engineering, Data Science, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience 
 
 What we offer 
 
 Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career 
 Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching 
 Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents 
 Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not  
 Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more 
 Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits 
 Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! 
 Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces 
 In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits. 
 Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process. 
 Base Pay Range: Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC) $110,000 — $110,000 USD Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity. 
 If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. 
 AI Usage Disclosure: Robinhood uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruiting process. These tools enhance the efficiency and consistency of our hiring process; however, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. 
 Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. Please review the  Privacy Policy for your country of application.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant (Communications & Marketing)
jobs.excerpt:
Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Why this role?

We are looking for a solutions-driven, detail-oriented, organized Executive Assistant to support our leadership team in Toronto, New York and beyond. Reporting to the EA Manager, this person will have the opportunity to work cross-functionally and provide high value and impact to the leadership team of the Comms and Marketing Teams and the company as a whole. If you are someone that thrives in a dynamic, collaborative, and fast-paced environment and are interested in joining a company that’s in growth mode, we’d be delighted to hear from you!

Please Note: We are looking for candidates based in the Eastern timezone (Toronto/New York etc)

As an Executive Assistant, you will:

 - Manage the day-to-day schedules for our Comms and Marketing leadership team, including calendaring, booking meetings and other commitments (where necessary) to ensure a balanced and efficient workday

 - Coordinate internal and external meetings (think 1:1s, partner meetings) and assist with documentation that may be required in conjunction with meetings

 - Arrange international/domestic travel and logistics for our leadership team, including booking flights and accommodations, scheduling, and expense reconciliation

 - Work to identify new ways to add value and proactively take on tasks that can help our leadership team be more productive. We’re looking for someone who loves to optimize operations and processes and is equally excited to share their ideas with our team!

 - Be willing to take on special projects like supporting team events, off sites or community-building activities

 - Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders while maintaining a strict level of confidentiality

 - Create and maintain internal documentation, share knowledge, and also work on formatting communications for the leadership team

You may be a good fit if you:

 - Have 3 - 7 years of experience working as an Executive Assistant, Administrative Assistant, or equivalent experience

 - Anticipate others’ needs and can work proactively to address them

 - Have previous experience partnering with senior leaders in a fast-paced, growing, innovative environment

 - Have experience managing multiple calendars, demonstrating flexibility and problem-solving abilities to adjust or prioritize schedules

FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS:

 - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

 - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

 - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

 - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

 - Annual enrichment benefits:
 
 Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.
 
 Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

 - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

 - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

 - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

 - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

 - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

 - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. 

We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs.

We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.

Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

jobs.excerpt:
About Anthropic 
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role 
 As the GTM Enablement Trainer, Claude Products, you'll teach Anthropic's global field organization how to use our products, both to do their own work better and to position Claude credibly with customers. Anthropic ships quickly, and the surface area of what we build is growing faster than any individual seller can track. The job has two halves. The first is enabling our own people to be power users of Claude, so the field is the most sophisticated user of the product we sell. The second is enabling them to position it: to run a credible technical conversation with a customer, anticipate the hard questions, and hold their own with a technical buyer. 
 The best person in this role sees around corners. You won't wait for a launch to be announced before you start building enablement for it. You'll be embedded enough with Product and Applied AI to know what's coming, and opinionated enough to say which surfaces need real enablement investment and which don't. You'll need enough technical credibility to earn the respect of engineers and enough commercial fluency to earn the respect of sellers. You should also find more energy in enabling people to use what we build than in building it yourself. 
 Key responsibilities: 
 
 Own product enablement for the global field organization, spanning new launches, existing capabilities, and the product roadmap ahead 
 Build the programs that make Anthropic sellers genuinely expert users of Claude in their own daily work 
 Create enablement that equips the field to position our products with technical and business buyers, including demo readiness, objection handling, and competitive framing 
 Partner closely with Product, Product Marketing, and Applied AI to get early visibility into what is shipping and to shape how it reaches the field 
 Anticipate which new product surfaces will require significant enablement investment, and make the case for that investment before launch 
 Build and maintain the product certification path that credentials sellers on our core products 
 Create high-quality enablement content including demo scripts, technical talk tracks, solution guides, and competitive positioning material 
 Establish feedback loops that carry field and customer signal about product gaps back to Product and Product Marketing 
 
 Minimum qualifications: 

 Experience bridging sales and technical audiences in a role such as solutions engineering, sales engineering, technical enablement, product marketing, or technical account management 

 Hands-on, regular use of AI assistants and agentic tools (e.g., Claude, Claude Code) in your own real-world workflows 

 Working technical knowledge of how LLM products work (e.g., prompting, context, tool use, APIs), enough to demo them live and field technical questions from engineering buyers 

 Experience turning complex, fast-moving technical products into enablement content such as demo scripts, technical talk tracks, solution guides, or training curricula 

 Experience writing and presenting technical material for audiences with very different levels of technical depth 

 Preferred qualifications 

 Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs, agentic frameworks, or developer tooling 

 Experience owning launch readiness for a technical product across a global field organization 

 Prior experience as a solutions engineer or sales engineer carrying a technical win 

 Experience building technical certification programs 

 A track record of shipping enablement content that the field actually uses 

 Experience partnering with Product or Product Marketing to prepare a field team ahead of launch, not after it 

 Experience building programs from 0 to 1 in fast-paced, ambiguous environments 

   The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.  
 For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $190,000 — $270,000 USD Logistics 
 Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience 
 Required field of study:  A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience 
 Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position 
 Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. 
 Visa sponsorship:  We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. 
 We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit  anthropic.com/careers  directly for confirmed position openings. 
 How we're different 
 We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. 
 The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. 
 Come work with us! 
 Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:  Learn about  our policy for using AI in our application process.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Pricing Strategist focused on GTM, you will help shape pricing strategy for B2B enterprise customers across our product portfolio. Working within Finance and partnering with GTM, Sales, and Product, you will focus on pricing analytics, price performance, and the effectiveness of credit programs while contributing to broader commercial strategy.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

 - Build regular pricing-performance reviews, analyze discounting and concessions, and turn findings into better pricing guidance.

 - Develop commercial strategies and pricing programs for customer segments such as education, startups, and government.

 - Define objectives and success measures for credit programs and promotions, and evaluate their return on investment.

 - Translate segment goals and product pricing strategy into scalable pricing frameworks and commercial structures.

 - Partner on strategic enterprise deals to align commercial proposals with sound deal economics and pricing strategy.

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU

 - Approach problems from first principles, identify root causes, and develop clear options for stakeholders.

 - Work effectively through ambiguity and differing perspectives.

 - Understand how sales organizations operate and collaborate well across GTM strategy, Finance, and Product.

 - Bring relevant experience from consulting, strategy and operations, or pricing, particularly work involving analytical teams.

Experience with pricing analytics, pricing frameworks, discounting guardrails, or new-product pricing is helpful, but a strictly pricing-specific background is not required.
