jobs.title: Sales Development Representative - Austin, TX
jobs.excerpt:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI. What is The Role: 
 Elastic is expanding its Sales Development team to support the explosive adoption of our offerings. Companies like Netflix, Lyft, Facebook, The New York Times, and Tinder (yeah, that Tinder) are looking to Elastic to help solve their big data problems. As a Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will play a critical role in the success of our sales organization by proactively identifying, nurturing, and creating new opportunities. Unlike most Sales Development organizations, we care about the quality of the interactions you have with our users more than the quantity of calls you make in a day. At Elastic, you will work with current users to understand their use case and help them navigate their Elastic journey. We provide office space for in-person trainings, collaboration, and team building which is used by SDRs on average of 1-2 days per week depending on tenure, team, and preference. The in-person collaboration helps our SDRs to build stronger relationships and develop in a more collaborative and supportive environment. 
 What You Will Be Doing: 
 
 Collaborate with sales, marketing and our partner team to develop new strategies to build our sales pipeline and grow our business 
 Balance the reactive work of responding to interested users with a creative and proactive approach to identify new opportunities 
 Use Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn, and other prospecting tools to research accounts, identify key contacts and craft targeted messaging 
 Learn our technology and effectively communicate our value proposition with a technical audience. Work to understand their goals and challenges to better understand how we can help 
 
 What You Bring: 
 
 1 years of SaaS sales experience 
 Willing to be in the Austin, TX office 3 days a week. 
 Open to feedback, genuinely curious and constantly looking for ways to learn and improve 
 Genuine love of technology, with the ability to learn and communicate complex technical concepts - Don’t worry, we’ll give you a lot of resources! 
 Not afraid to pick up the phone - this is the path to success! 
 Hitting your monthly targets by being results oriented and focussed on achieving, through self discipline, creativity and passion 
 Wanting to be a part of something bigger than yourself 
 Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary plus a variable component, that together comprise the On-Target Earnings (OTE).  On-Target Earnings (OTE) are based on a 70/30 pay mix (base salary / target variable).   
 The typical starting OTE range for new hires in this role is listed below.  This range represents the lowest to highest OTE we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.  We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future.   
 An employee's position within the OTE range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs. 
 Elastic believes that employees should have the opportunity to share in the value that we create together for our shareholders. Therefore, in addition to cash compensation, this role is currently eligible to participate in Elastic's stock program.  Our total rewards package also includes a company-matched 401k with dollar-for-dollar matching up to 6% of eligible earnings, along with a range of other benefits offered with a holistic emphasis on employee well-being. The typical starting salary range for this role is: $46,200 — $73,000 USD The typical starting Target Variable range for this role is: $19,700 — $31,200 USD The typical starting On-Target Earnings (OTE) range for this role is: $65,900 — $104,200 USD Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People 
 As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do. 
 We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do. 
 
 Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary 
 Health coverage for you and your family in many locations 
 Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles 
 Generous number of vacation days each year 
 Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service 
 Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love 
 Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave 
 
 Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation. 
 We welcome individuals with disabilities and strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all individuals. To request an accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email candidate_accessibility@elastic.co .  We will reply to your request within 24 business hours of submission. 
 Applicants have rights under Federal Employment Laws, view posters linked below: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Poster;   Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination Provision Poster; Employee Polygraph Protection Act (EPPA) Poster and Know Your Rights (Poster)

If you are located in or are a national of one of the listed countries or regions, an export license may be required as a condition of your employment in this role. Please note that national origin and/or nationality do not affect eligibility for employment with Elastic. 
 Please see  here  for our Privacy Statement.

 We provide office space for in-person trainings, collaboration, and team building which is used by SDRs on average of 1-2 days per week depending on tenure, team, and preference. The in-person collaboration helps our SDRs to build stronger relationships and develop in a more collaborative and supportive environment. 
 What is The Role: 
 As an SDR organization, we spend most of our time finding new business to expand Elastic's presence in all market segments. Your responsibilities will include:  
 
 Collaborate with sales, marketing and our partner team to develop new strategies to build our sales pipeline and grow our business 
 Balance the reactive work of responding to interested users with a creative and proactive approach to identify new opportunities 
 Use Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn, and other prospecting tools to research accounts, identify key contacts and craft targeted messaging 
 Learn our technology and effectively communicate our value proposition with a technical audience. Work to understand their goals and challenges to better understand how we can help 
 
 What You Bring: 
 There isn’t a cookie-cutter mold for who we hire, but there are some common qualities each member of our high-performing team possesses:   
 
 0-1 year work experience 
 Sales or customer service experience a plus 
 Willing to be in the Austin, TX office a few days a week 
 Open to feedback, genuinely curious and constantly looking for ways to learn and improve 
 Genuine love of technology, with the ability to learn and communicate complex technical concepts - Don’t worry, we’ll give you a lot of resources! 
 Not afraid to pick up the phone - this is the path to success! 
 Hitting your monthly targets by being results oriented and focussed on achieving, through self discipline, creativity and passion 
 Wanting to be a part of something bigger than yourself 
 
 Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary plus a variable component, that together comprise the On-Target Earnings (OTE).  On-Target Earnings (OTE) are based on a 70/30 pay mix (base salary / target variable).   
 The typical starting OTE range for new hires in this role is listed below.  This range represents the lowest to highest OTE we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.  We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future.   
 An employee's position within the OTE range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs. 
 Elastic believes that employees should have the opportunity to share in the value that we create together for our shareholders. Therefore, in addition to cash compensation, this role is currently eligible to participate in Elastic's stock program.  Our total rewards package also includes a company-matched 401k with dollar-for-dollar matching up to 6% of eligible earnings, along with a range of other benefits offered with a holistic emphasis on employee well-being.  As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

jobs.title: Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt:
We’re looking for a highly creative, entrepreneurial, and organized Manager, Startup Marketing to expand MongoDB’s AI-native marketing strategy and strengthen our presence across the startup and AI/Digital-Native ecosystem in India. The role reports to the Head of India Marketing and will be part of the International Marketing organisation. 
 This role combines strategy and execution, with a focus on ecosystem engagement, community building, and scalable startup programming. You will help strengthen MongoDB’s presence among high-growth, venture-backed startups across India by building relationships with founders, venture capital firms, accelerators, and startup communities. In partnership with the broader  marketing team, you will design and execute programs, events, and partnerships that increase awareness, adoption, and long-term affinity for MongoDB. As a regional representative for MongoDB, you will support the planning and delivery of startup-focused initiatives such as hackathons, demo nights, founder dinners, and conference-adjacent activations. This role sits at the intersection of partnerships, community, events, regional marketing, and content, and requires someone who is equally comfortable shaping ideas and driving hands-on execution. 
 We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model. 
 Position Expectations 
 Serve as one of the MongoDB representatives within the India startup ecosystem: Build and maintain strong relationships across the India startup community, including founders, operators, VCs, accelerators, and key ecosystem partnersDrive high-value startup acquisition: Develop and execute a targeted strategy to engage and convert high-potential startups in the region into the MongoDB for Startups programExpand MongoDB’s physical presence in India: In partnership with broader India marketing team, develop and execute a regional event strategy focused on high-impact founder programming, including VC-partnered events, demo days, hackathons, founder dinners, and other community activationsPartner with startups to highlight success: Work with internal teams and startup customers to surface and develop compelling stories showcasing startups building on MongoDB 
 
 Own cross-functional alignment for the regional startup audience: Collaborate with teams such as MongoDB Ventures, Regional Marketing, Strategic Events, Sales, and Builder Relations to integrate startup-focused programming and ensure regional initiatives effectively reach founders and developers 
 Measure impact and continuously optimize: Monitor and track success metrics for startup engagement, such as attendance quality, funded-founder participation, and program applications, and use insights to refine strategy and programming 
 
 The right candidate for this role will be: 
 
 Have 4+ years of experience in marketing, community, ecosystem, or events roles focused on startups, developers, or technical founders 
 Have experience leading projects or programs and collaborating across teams, with the ability to drive initiatives from strategy through execution  
 Possess familiarity with the Indian startup ecosystem, ideally with relationships across founders, VCs, accelerators, and key founder communities 
 Have experience working in or closely with startups or venture capital firms, with a solid understanding of how early-stage companies operate and grow 
 Thrive in fast-moving environments, helping build and scale programs, partnerships, and community initiatives 
 Be highly organized and execution-oriented, able to manage multiple initiatives and stakeholders while delivering high-quality programs 
 Be data-driven, able to track key engagement metrics and communicate the impact of regional initiatives 
 Communicate clearly and confidently with founders, investors, and senior internal stakeholders 
 Operate with a high degree of ownership and initiative, collaborating with a globally distributed team while maintaining an active presence within the India AI startup ecosystem 
 
 About MongoDB 
 MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. 
 With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software. 
 Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.  
 To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy , we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB , and help us make an impact on the world! 
 MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter. 
 MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

jobs.excerpt: Compensation: $80,000-$120,000 per year Location: United States – Remote or Omaha, NE - Hybrid The job: As a Product Marketing Manager, AI at Buildertrend, you'll be a strategic part of driving our next phase of growth and help shape how contractors understand and use the technology that is changing residential and commercial construction. You’ll turn complex AI capabilities into clear customer value, lead go-to-market efforts, and equip sales and customer success teams to help builders get more from Buildertrend. Your work will connect product strategy to real customer outcomes, helping contractors spend less time on paperwork and more time growing their businesses. What you will do: Lead go-to-market planning for AI capabilities and broader platform initiatives, aligning product, sales, marketing and customer success around launch goals, timelines and customer value. Develop clear, differentiated messaging and positioning that translates AI capabilities into practical benefits for contractors and supports pipeline and revenue growth. Partner with product managers, sales leaders, demand generation and customer success to incorporate customer, market and competitive insights into product marketing strategies. Create sales enablement tools and content that help sellers explain product value, address customer needs and move opportunities forward. Turn customer insights into actionable messaging, campaigns and programs that reflect what builders and remodelers need to run their businesses more effectively. Drive feature adoption by partnering with customer success and marketing on content and programs that help customers understand what’s new, why it matters and how to get value from it. Become a subject matter expert on key areas of the Buildertrend platform, including AI-powered capabilities, and translate complex product details for internal and external audiences. Develop thought leadership and competitive content that demonstrates Buildertrend’s understanding of construction technology and the needs of the industry. Use AI tools thoughtfully to improve your work, while applying sound judgment, learning continuously and owning the quality and accuracy of your final work. Who you are and what you need: Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, communications, or related field, or equivalent experience. 3 to 6 years of product marketing experience in B2B SaaS, with experience launching products or features and delivering high-quality work on schedule. Previous experience in construction technology, field service, vertical SaaS or positioning AI-powered products for nontechnical audiences is a plus. Strong messaging and positioning skills, with the ability to make complex product capabilities clear and relevant to both contractors and sales teams. Experience partnering with sales and customer success teams to develop practical tools and content that support customer conversations and business results. A relationship builder who can gather input from across the organization, bring people together around a clear direction and move work forward with limited structure. Comfortable balancing immediate priorities with longer-term product marketing initiatives and adjusting as product and business needs change. Curious about customers and motivated to understand what builders and remodelers care about, what gets in their way and how technology can help. A portfolio or examples of product launches, messaging, sales enablement materials or other product marketing work you can discuss in detail. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize information, present ideas clearly and adjust the level of detail for the audience. We are giving you: Exceptional health packages, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus life insurance and short- and long-term disability benefits A 401(k) plan with Buildertrend matching contributions to help you plan for the future Generous paid time off, 11 paid holidays, plus personal days to make sure you have time to recharge Parental leave and paid sabbaticals to support you during life’s big moments Volunteer time off – because giving back matters Wellness program and onsite fitness center to keep you feeling your best Opportunities for hybrid or remote work to give you the flexibility you need Technology reimbursement to help cover costs for the tech you need to do your job from home Free daily lunches when you're at our HQ office, plus monthly events to connect with your team Who we are: Great builders don’t just manage projects – they run successful businesses. That’s where Buildertrend comes in. As the leading residential construction management platform, we give contractors the power to control their financials, schedules, team workflows and client relationships – all in one system. No more juggling disconnected tools or guessing on profitability. With nearly two decades of industry expertise, Buildertrend helps builders work smarter, scale faster and stay ahead of the competition. If you want to learn more about us, check out: https://buildertrend.com/about/ Working at Buildertrend: At Buildertrend, we fully recognize that we all work so we can live better lives—we appreciate and respect that this is a job and not your whole life. What makes Buildertrend so special is a commitment to ensuring you can have the best job, work with the best people, and live your best life outside of work. Our goal is to create a culture where everyone can make an impact on our customers, communities, and each other. In short: We want you to be who you are, love what you do, and build your best life. jobs.title: Manager, Growth Marketing (REMOTE)
jobs.excerpt:
WHO WE AREEnableComp earned its reputation in the toughest corners of the revenue cycle by solving the complex claims no one else could. We developed Complex Revenue Intelligence (CRI), a smarter approach to predict and prevent revenue loss. Powered by the e360 RCM® AI-driven platform and the most expansive complex revenue cycle data set, today EnableComp helps more than 1,000 hospitals nationwide recover $3 billion annually from complex claims, denials, and revenue recovery. By cutting through complexity, we help hospitals thrive, resulting in recognition as Black Book’s #1 Specialty RCM provider for complex claims and revenue integrity in 2024 and 2025, a multi-year Top Workplaces honoree, and a SOC 2 Type II and HITRUST e1-certified platform.Our Vision is to empower healthcare providers to focus on patient care, not revenue cycle complexity. Our Mission is to uncover what others miss—turning every client dollar recovered into insight that helps prevent future loss. We live our Core Values of Uncompromising Integrity, Ecstatic Clients, and Empowered Team Members by operating with trust, accountability, and a “we before me” mindset. We pursue Innovation and Profitable Growth through continuous improvement and thoughtful problem-solving, and we believe work should include Fun—celebrating success, recognizing our people, and maintaining healthy work-life balance.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Manager, Growth Marketing owns EnableComp’s demand generation engine — planning and executing the multi-channel campaigns that build pipeline, and, as our first dedicated content hire, creating the blog posts, ebooks, landing pages, and nurture content those campaigns run on. This role builds on the technical infrastructure the GTM Engineer maintains and the positioning the Director, Product Marketing sets, translating both into campaigns that generate and nurture qualified leads.

Reporting to the VP, Marketing, the Manager will partner closely with Product Marketing, the Commercial Enablement Director, the Manager of Event Marketing & Strategic Partnerships, and the SDR function to ensure a consistent, well-coordinated path from first touch to qualified pipeline. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports at this time.

The Job Responsibilities Include
• Plan, build, and execute multi-channel demand generation campaigns across email, paid social, SEM, retargeting, and organic channels.
• Own marketing-sourced pipeline targets and report on campaign performance against revenue goals.
• Manage the demand generation budget, tracking spend against ROI and reallocating based on channel performance.
• Own funnel content end-to-end: blog posts, ebooks/guides, landing pages, and nurture email copy that fuel campaigns — this is our first dedicated content hire, so the expectation is building the engine, not just staffing it.
• Ensure all campaign content reflects current positioning and messaging maintained by the Director, Product Marketing.
• Establish a scalable, repeatable content calendar and production workflow.
• Build and manage lead nurture email programs and campaign workflows inside HubSpot, working within the lead scoring and account routing logic the GTM Engineer designs and maintains.
• Partner with the GTM Engineer on campaign-specific automation needs and data requirements, without owning the underlying tech stack, integrations, or scoring/routing architecture.
• Monitor and troubleshoot campaign-level workflow issues, escalating systemic or infrastructure issues to the GTM Engineer.
• Partner with the Manager, Event Marketing & Strategic Partnerships on webinar and event promotion strategy, registration goals, and post-event lead nurture (Events owns strategy, logistics, and execution; Growth Marketing owns the pipeline goals and follow-up).
• Partner with the Director, Product Marketing to ensure campaigns and content reflect current narrative, positioning, and competitive messaging.
• Partner with the SDR function on lead handoff, MQL quality feedback, and conversion tracking.
• Analyze campaign and content performance data to identify what’s working, kill what isn’t, and continuously optimize for MQL volume, conversion rate, and cost per acquisition.
• Stay current on emerging channels and AI-powered marketing/content tools, piloting new tactics to keep programs ahead of the curve.
• Other duties as assigned.

Requirements & Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field required; equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered.
• 3–5 years of experience in demand generation, growth marketing, or a related B2B marketing role.
• Experience in healthcare, healthcare technology, Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), or another complex B2B industry is a plus.
• Hands-on experience with marketing automation platforms (HubSpot preferred) and CRM systems (Salesforce).
• Strong writing skills — comfortable independently drafting blog posts, email copy, and landing page copy, since this role owns content without a dedicated content team behind it.
• Strong analytical skills, with experience pulling and interpreting campaign data to make decisions.
• Comfort partnering with a technical GTM/RevOps function (e.g., a GTM Engineer) on automation and data needs without owning the underlying systems.
• Regular and predictable attendance.
• Must have strong computer proficiency and understand how to use office applications, including MS Office (PowerPoint, Word, Excel, Teams, Outlook), Zoom, and other learning technology.
• To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Special Considerations & Prerequisites
• Practices and adheres to EnableComp’s Core Values, Vision and Mission.
• Individual contributor role; no direct reports at this time.
• A great candidate is self-directed and comfortable owning ambiguous, cross-functional problems; treats data hygiene as non-negotiable; and can translate technical workflows into plain-language impact for Sales and Marketing stakeholders.
• Strong project management and prioritization skills; comfortable running multiple campaigns simultaneously.
• A bias toward experimentation and iteration, including piloting AI-enabled content and marketing tools.
• Minimal travel required (less than 20%), primarily for occasional team or company offsites.
• Ability to work at a computer for extended periods; standard office or remote work environment.

EnableComp is an Equal Opportunity Employer M/F/D/V. All applicants will be considered for this position based upon experience and knowledge, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, marital, disabled or veteran status. We are committed to creating and maintaining a workforce environment that is free from any form of discrimination or harassment.
EnableComp recruits, develops and retains the industry's top talent. As the employer of choice in the complex claims industry, EnableComp takes pride in our continuous commitment to building and maintaining a culture centered around fostering the professional growth and development of our people. We believe that investing in our employees is the key to our success, and we are dedicated to providing them with the tools, resources, and support they need to thrive and grow their career here. At EnableComp, we are committed to living up to our core values each and every day, and we believe that this commitment is what sets us apart from other companies. If you are looking for a company that values its employees and is dedicated to helping them achieve their full potential, then EnableComp is the place for you.

jobs.title: GTM Strategy and Operations Associate
jobs.excerpt:
We’re looking for an experienced Associate to join our growing GTM Strategy & Operations team. Our team solves complex problems that require insight, creativity, and execution through building scalable processes, tools, and systems for our rapidly growing global business. You will own the day-to-day management and strategy of the sales productivity tool ecosystem that powers our Sales and Customer Success organizations - including contact intelligence, outbound sequencing, and data enrichment platforms. Doing this successfully requires a deep understanding of the “day in the life” for field teams, strong vendor management skills, and the ability to translate business needs into tooling solutions that help Datadog grow 10x. 
 At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them. 
 You Will 
 
 Own the tool portfolio: Manage the strategy, lifecycle, and day-to-day administration of Datadog’s sales productivity tools, including contact intelligence, outbound sequencing, and data enrichment platforms  
 Lead AI tooling strategy: Identify, evaluate, and pilot AI-powered tools and features that enhance sales productivity - from AI-assisted prospecting and enrichment to intelligent sequencing and personalization - and help define Datadog’s forward-looking AI tooling roadmap for the Sales and CS organizations 
 Drive vendor performance: Manage vendor relationships, contract renewals, and commercial negotiations in partnership with Legal, Finance, and Procurement - including benchmarking tools against alternatives and driving competitive pricing 
 Measure impact: Define and track success metrics across all managed tools (e.g., adoption rates, data quality, pipeline influenced) and use findings to make data-driven consolidation, expansion, or replacement decisions 
 Partner with the field: Work closely with Sales and Customer Success to understand workflow needs and translate them into tooling improvements that directly improve rep productivity 
 Lead enablement: Own tool onboarding, change management, and adoption programs in collaboration with the Sales Enablement team to ensure field teams get maximum value from every platform 
 Evaluate new tools: Lead structured vendor evaluation processes (e.g., RFPs, pilots, POCs) for emerging platforms, including building business cases and presenting investment recommendations to GTM leadership 
 Ensure seamless integration: Collaborate with GTM Systems to maintain and improve integrations between sales productivity tools, Salesforce CRM, and the broader GTM tech stack 
 Set the standard: Build and enforce governance frameworks, acceptable use policies, and data hygiene standards across all managed tools to ensure consistency and compliance 
 
 Requirements 
 
 Experience: 2-4+ years of experience in GTM Strategy & Operations, management consulting, banking, analytics, or a similar analytical field, ideally within SaaS or high‑growth B2B technology. 
 AI innovation: Strong interest in exploring, launching, and scaling new GTM AI technologies to improve sales development productivity and effectiveness 
 Vendor management: Proven ability to own vendor relationships and contribute to commercial negotiations, including renewals and expansions 
 Tool fluency: Hands-on familiarity with the B2B sales technology landscape, including contact intelligence (e.g., ZoomInfo, Cognism), outbound sequencing (e.g., Groove, Salesloft, Outreach), and data enrichment tools (e.g., Clay, Clearbit, Crunchbase) 
 Cross-functional collaboration: Strong track record of partnering with Sales and CS teams to identify pain points and drive tooling solutions from requirements through rollout 
 Analytical mindset: Comfortable measuring tool adoption, ROI, and usage trends - and communicating those findings clearly to senior stakeholders 
 CRM knowledge: Solid understanding of Salesforce CRM and how sales productivity tools integrate into the broader GTM tech stack 
 Communication: Effective communicator, both written and verbal, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously 
 Ownership mentality: Self-starter who takes initiative, operates independently, and drives projects through to completion without heavy oversight 
 
 Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply. 
 Bonus Points 
 
 SaaS background: Experience at a high-growth B2B SaaS company managing a GTM or sales tool portfolio 
 AI passion: Stays current on the latest AI news, has a passion for experimentation, has fully integrated AI into professional workflows, and vibe codes on the weekend 
 Broader stack exposure: Familiarity with adjacent tools such as buyer intent platforms (e.g., Bombora, G2) or conversation intelligence (e.g., Gong) 
 Technical aptitude: Working knowledge of APIs and how sales tools connect to CRM systems and data infrastructure 
 Full-funnel experience: Experience supporting tool adoption across Sales Development, Account Executive, and Customer Success teams 
 
 Benefits & Growth: 
 
 Generous and competitive benefits package 
 New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan 
 Continuous career development and pathing opportunities 
 Employee-focused best in class onboarding 
 Internal mentor and cross-departmental buddy program 
 Friendly and inclusive workplace culture 
 
 Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog. 
 #LI-Hybrid Datadog offers a competitive salary and equity package, and may include variable compensation. Actual compensation is based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, Datadog offers a wide range of best in class, comprehensive and inclusive employee benefits for this role including healthcare, dental, parental planning, and mental health benefits, a 401(k) plan and match, paid time off, fitness reimbursements, and a discounted employee stock purchase plan. The reasonably estimated yearly salary for this role at Datadog is: $100,000 — $146,000 USD

 Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. Learn more about #DatadogLife on Instagram , LinkedIn, and Datadog Learning Center.

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager (Construction Technology, PLG & AI)
jobs.excerpt: Required Skills:• Experience driving growth in construction tech, AECO, or other complex B2B SaaS verticals • Familiarity with a Product Qualified Lead (PQL) motion • Hands-on experience with product analytics and experimentation platforms • Experience with marketing automation, segmentation, and personalization • Background in B2B SaaS, digital commerce, or subscription models Position Overview Client is seeking a Growth Marketing Manager to accelerate growth within Client Forma through product-led growth (PLG) strategies and AI-powered execution. This is an individual contributor contract role on our Digital Growth team. You will optimize monetization journeys that guide customers from entry-level and self-serve offerings toward higher-value solutions across the Forma Industry Cloud, with a focus on construction. You will apply a scientist's mindset to growth: forming hypotheses, running structured experiments, interpreting behavioral data, and scaling what works. This role requires fluency in leveraging AI-powered workflows and tools to accelerate progress toward business goals. You will be expected to use AI to enhance experimentation velocity, streamline analysis, improve personalization, and increase operational efficiency — including designing automated workflows and building or managing AI agents to support growth initiatives. Working cross-functionally with Product, Analytics, Lifecycle Marketing, and eCommerce teams, you will help evolve our Product Qualified Lead (PQL) motion for Forma customers — ensuring that product engagement signals translate into relevant, timely, and data-informed growth actions. This is a high-impact, high-ownership role for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, embraces AI as a force multiplier, and is motivated by building scalable growth engines under ambitious timelines. What You'll Do • Define and optimize the Forma growth funnel — from acquisition and activation through expansion, cross-sell, and upgrade • Design and execute rapid experimentation programs across onboarding, in-product messaging, lifecycle communications, and eCommerce touchpoints • Translate product usage data and behavioral signals into prioritized growth hypotheses and test plans • Partner with Product and Analytics teams to identify high-intent engagement signals and strengthen the Product Qualified Lead (PQL) motion • Analyze experiment results and funnel performance to generate actionable insights and inform investment decisions • Support development of targeted messaging and lifecycle content aligned to customer stage, usage behavior, and expansion opportunities • Partner with Analytics to build dashboards and reporting frameworks that track activation, conversion, expansion, retention, and monetization impact • Quantify opportunity size and expected business impact to prioritize initiatives effectively • Leverage AI-powered tools and workflows where applicable to improve experimentation velocity, personalization, and operational efficiency • Manage cross-functional growth initiatives end-to-end, ensuring alignment, accountability, and timely delivery What We're Looking For • A track record of running structured experimentation programs (A/B, multivariate, rapid-test frameworks) with real hypotheses, metrics, and outcomes you can speak to concretely • Growth marketing experience where you owned funnel outcomes — not demand generation, campaign management, or top-of-funnel lead volume as the primary measure of success • Strong analytical instincts and fluency using behavioral and performance data to make decisions • Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally with Product, Analytics, and engineering partners, and to make progress without formal authority over them • Working fluency with product-led growth (PLG) principles and lifecycle strategy • Hands-on comfort using AI tools to accelerate analysis, content, and workflow • Strong project management and clear communication Tools You'll Work With • Our environment includes product analytics and experimentation tooling (e.g., Pendo), customer data and segmentation via Segment, marketing automation via Marketo, and AI agent tooling via Relevance AI. Fluency in comparable platforms transfers; willingness to work in ours is what matters. How to Apply • To help us move quickly and to see how you think, please include a short written response (max 300 words) to the following, in addition to your resume: Pick one point in a new-user trial funnel for a self-serve product. State a hypothesis for improving activation, the single metric you'd move, and how you'd structure the experiment to test it. • Applications without this response will not be reviewed. We read for specificity and sound experimental reasoning, not polish.**Only those lawfully authorized to work in the designated country associated with the position will be considered.** **Please note that all Position start dates and duration are estimates and may be reduced or lengthened based upon a client’s business needs and requirements.**

jobs.title: GTM Strategy/Operations Associate
jobs.excerpt:
The GTM Strategy & Operations Associate will join a global team focused on driving Datadog’s next phase of growth. In this role, you will identify opportunities for revenue growth, evaluate business tradeoffs, and partner with senior leaders to shape go-to-market strategy. You will drive key planning processes, including capacity and quota planning, optimization and expansion strategies, and KPI design and measurement. You will also lead strategic and operational initiatives that improve execution while building experience across complex, high-impact business challenges. 
 At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them. 
 What You’ll Do: 
 
 Develop short- and long-term go-to-market strategies by identifying growth opportunities, setting business priorities, and aligning sales and growth targets 
 Own quota planning for the global Sales organization, including building and maintaining quota models, adapting them to organizational changes, and driving stakeholder alignment 
 Analyze sales and go-to-market data to identify trends and channel efficiency, and develop models that inform planning, quota setting, and strategic decisions 
 Partner with Sales and other go-to-market leaders to shape strategic priorities, translate future-state goals into actionable plans, and execute key initiatives 
 Build dashboards and define KPIs that translate complex data into actionable insights for business leaders 
 Lead and support high-priority cross-functional initiatives that improve execution and accelerate revenue growth 
 
 Who You Are: 
 
 You have 2–4 years of experience in go-to-market, growth, or revenue strategy; management consulting; investment banking or equity research; business analysis; or a related field 
 You can break down complex or ambiguous business problems, identify key tradeoffs, and develop clear, actionable recommendations 
 You have strong quantitative modeling and analytical skills, with attention to detail and the ability to communicate key insights to senior business stakeholders 
 You communicate clearly in writing and verbally, including synthesizing complex concepts and developing presentations for senior and executive audiences 
 You have demonstrated the ability to own multiple projects and collaborate cross-functionally with stakeholders across functions such as Sales, Marketing, Strategy, and Product 
 You have experience with, or an interest in learning, business intelligence and data analysis tools such as Tableau, Looker, Metabase, SQL, or Python; experience with Sales or Customer Success strategy, SaaS, or high-tech businesses is a plus 
 
 Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply. 
 Benefits & Growth: 
 
 Generous and competitive benefits package 
 New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan 
 Continuous career development and pathing opportunities 
 Employee-focused best in class onboarding 
 Internal mentor and cross-departmental buddy program 
 Friendly and inclusive workplace culture 
 
 Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog. 
 #LI-Hybrid Datadog offers a competitive salary and equity package, and may include variable compensation. Actual compensation is based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, Datadog offers a wide range of best in class, comprehensive and inclusive employee benefits for this role including healthcare, dental, parental planning, and mental health benefits, a 401(k) plan and match, paid time off, fitness reimbursements, and a discounted employee stock purchase plan. The reasonably estimated yearly salary for this role at Datadog is: $100,000 — $133,000 USD 
 About Datadog:  
 Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. Learn more about #DatadogLife on Instagram , LinkedIn, and Datadog Learning Center.

jobs.excerpt:
The Brand Analytics Manager owns measurement across custom advertising campaigns: defining KPI frameworks, building shared tooling, and ensuring the business measures consistently rather than campaign by campaign. Brand Innovation Lab runs these campaigns for major brands across Amazon. You'll work with Solutions Managers, Brand Strategists, Design Technologists, and Engineers, advising on measurement strategy and tagging before campaigns launch. You answer complex questions with data, using Amazon's first-party data alongside third-party measurement products. You are comfortable using SQL to query across large datasets. You scale your measurement solutions to work across the business. Key job responsibilities - Define measurement plans, KPIs, benchmarks, and full-funnel measurement that work across the business - Build self-service tools (dashboards, automated reports) that reduce dependence on ad-hoc requests - Document measurement methodologies for use across 11+ countries - Work with Engineering to embed measurement best practices into existing systems - Analyse campaign results and deliver findings and recommendations to creative and strategy teams - Present findings to internal teams and, where relevant, to advertising clients About the team Brand Innovation Lab builds custom ad campaigns for brands on Amazon. The Brand Analytics & Measurement team is responsible for how those campaigns are measured. You'd be the third Brand Analytics Manager, working alongside the Head of Analytics & Measurement and another Brand Analytics Manager The team owns measurement strategy, tooling, and driving adoption of both across the organization.

- 3+ years of digital media or marketing strategy, data analysis, analytics & visualization experience - Knowledge of data visualization tools such as Quick Sight, Tableau, Power BI or other BI packages - Experience with data analytics platforms (Power BI, Python, SQL, Tableau), or experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (i.e. SQL, MS Power Query, Python) - Experience using very large datasets - 3+ years of database experience (e.g. SQL, NoSQL, Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, Kinesis)

jobs.excerpt:
About Gusto 
 At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve. 
   All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy . 
   AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process. About the Role: 
 At Symmetry, we're building the future of payroll compliance technology. We have a powerful vision and an ambitious growth plan—but brilliant strategy is nothing without tactical execution. That's where you come in. 
 We're looking for a Marketing Programs Specialist to be the operational backbone of our marketing engine—the person who turns strategy into shipped work across new business acquisition and client and product communications. This isn't a role about sitting in meetings or setting strategy; it's about making things happen, and making them happen faster than traditional marketing teams ever could. 
 You'll work hand-in-hand with two leaders: supporting the Demand Generation Manager to drive new client acquisition, and supporting the Product Marketing Manager to deliver client and product communications. And you'll do all of it as an AI-first marketer—using AI as your co-pilot in everything you touch. We believe the next generation of B2B marketers won't just use AI; they'll make it the default way they work. This role is built for exactly that person. 
 This is a high-impact execution role with a direct line to pipeline and revenue, offering a front-row seat to building a world-class, AI-first and B2B SaaS marketing function. 
 About the Team: 
 Symmetry's Marketing team is dedicated to building brand awareness and driving enterprise demand for our payroll compliance solutions. Our core mission is to achieve significant growth and position Symmetry as a leader in infrastructure for payroll tax compliance. We're developing a robust enterprise marketing team encompassing demand generation, product marketing, digital marketing, lifecycle marketing and analytics—built from the ground up with AI embedded in how we work. 
 This role reports to the CMO and works in close partnership with the Demand Gen Manager and Product Marketing Manager. You'll execute across two pillars: new business acquisition (with Demand Gen) and client and product communications (with Product Marketing), gaining broad experience across digital marketing, events, lifecycle and product communications, and AI-first operations while learning from an experienced and collaborative team. 
 You'll also have the opportunity to: 
 
 Build hands-on experience with a modern, AI-augmented marketing tech stack. 
 Become deeply fluent in AI tools and workflows—a skillset that will define the next decade of marketing careers. 
 Gain exposure to growth strategies that connect marketing activities directly to revenue. 
 Work cross-functionally with demand gen, product marketing, sales, product, and leadership—developing communication and collaboration skills that accelerate career growth. 
 
 Here's what you'll do day-to-day: 
 
 Grow into more ownership over campaigns and programs as you gain experience 
 Coordinate LinkedIn and Google Ads campaigns targeting prospects, using AI to accelerate audience research, draft and iterate ad copy variants, analyze creative performance, and surface optimization recommendations 
 Support planning and execution of prospect-facing webinars and digital campaigns, including registration and landing page setup, speaker coordination, Zoom management, and follow-up reporting in HubSpot, using AI to draft promotional copy, campaign briefs, and post-campaign summaries 
 Build and maintain acquisition nurtures and lead workflows in HubSpot, using AI to personalize messaging, iterate copy, and analyze engagement 
 Activate customer stories and case studies across channels, turning each story into campaign assets, nurtures, sales enablement materials, social content, and webinar talking points, using AI to produce multiple distributed assets from a single story 
 Distribute release notes and product updates to the developer persona across channels including in-product, email, docs, changelog, and community, using AI to translate engineering-written notes into developer-friendly communications and draft channel-specific variants 
 Execute customer-facing lifecycle programs in HubSpot, including onboarding nurtures, feature adoption sequences, expansion campaigns, and customer newsletters, using AI to personalize at scale and identify the highest-converting moments in the journey 
 Maintain a unified marketing calendar spanning acquisition and client/product communications, using AI to draft status updates, flag conflicts and dependencies, and turn raw campaign data into reports for leadership, while keeping prospect-facing and customer-facing messaging from colliding 
 
 Here's what we're looking for: 
 
 3+ years in a B2B marketing role, ideally in SaaS or technology. Exposure to demand generation, lifecycle marketing, customer marketing, or developer marketing is a plus. 
 Fluency with AI tools as your default way of working. You've gone beyond basic prompting—you've built custom GPTs or Claude Projects, automated workflows, or used AI tooling to solve real problems. 
 Organized and detail-oriented, able to manage multiple tasks and deadlines across parallel workstreams. 
 Reliable follow-through—you take ownership of your commitments. 
 Clear communicator who works well with internal teams (Demand Gen, Product Marketing, Sales) and external partners—and who can adapt tone for different audiences, including technical readers like developers. 
 Curiosity about how marketing influences not just net-new pipeline, but also customer retention and expansion revenue. 
 Comfortable learning new tools quickly—a skill that matters more than ever as the AI tooling landscape evolves monthly. 
 Experience with any of the following is a plus: 
 
 Marketing Automation (HubSpot or similar), including lifecycle workflows and customer segmentation 
 CRM (Salesforce or similar) 
 Events (Zoom or other webinar platforms) 
 Project Management (Notion, Asana, or similar) 
 AI & Automation Tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gumloop, Glean, or similar) 
 Developer-facing communication tools (changelog platforms, dev community tools, technical documentation systems) 

 Our cash compensation amount for this role is targeted at $63,830/yr- $78,724/yr in Scottsdale. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed above.  
 Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. Employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately 2-3 days per week (or more depending on role). The same office expectations apply to all Symmetry roles, Gusto's subsidiary, whose physical office is in Scottsdale.

jobs.location: Hybrid - San Francisco, New York City, Austin
jobs.excerpt:
About Vercel: 
 Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company. We free people and agents to ship what’s next. 
 For more than a decade, Vercel has shaped how the web is built. As the team behind Next.js, v0, and AI SDK, we create products that help builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience. 
 Now, software is entering a new era, and the next generation of products will not just be used by people. They will be built, extended, and operated by agents. 
 We are building the platform for that future, trusted by companies like  OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide . Whether you’re building our products, supporting our customers, growing our community, or shaping our story, you’ll help define what comes next. About the Role: 
 As a Growth Marketing Manager, you’ll design and execute multi-channel programs that guide developers and enterprise customers through their journey with Vercel—from onboarding and adoption to retention and expansion. Your work will directly influence how customers experience the platform, ensuring they realize the full value of Vercel’s products. 
 You’ll partner closely with the Growth Product Team, Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Data to deliver personalized, impactful lifecycle communications that scale globally. This is a high-visibility role with the opportunity to impact both revenue and customer engagement. 
 
 What You Will Do: 
 
 End-to-end lifecycle campaigns across email, in-app, and other owned & paid channels to drive activation, adoption, and long-term retention. 
 Segmentation and personalization strategies that deliver timely and relevant messages to developers and enterprise stakeholders. Develop and maintain customer journey maps to identify friction points, optimize touchpoints, and design end-to-end experiences that drive conversion, retention, and loyalty. 
 Automated workflows and experimentation, building scalable programs with behavioral triggers, A/B testing, and data-driven optimizations. 
 Campaign measurement and reporting, surfacing insights on performance and recommending opportunities for continuous improvement. 
 Cross-functional alignment, ensuring lifecycle marketing supports Sales and Customer Success priorities and ties into Vercel’s broader GTM strategy. 
 Creative and content collaboration, partnering with design and product marketing to develop messaging that resonates with both technical and business audiences. 

 About You: 
 
 4+ years of experience in lifecycle, CRM, or growth marketing, ideally within SaaS, developer tools, or B2B technology. 
 Proficiency with marketing automation tools (HubSpot, Iterable, Braze, Marketo) and analytics platforms (Amplitude, Segment, Looker, Mixpanel). 
 Proven ability to design and scale multi-channel lifecycle campaigns that drive measurable improvements in product adoption and retention. 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a track record of turning insights into actionable strategies. 
 Experience collaborating cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Design, and GTM teams. 
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical developers and enterprise buyers. 
 A growth mindset with passion for experimentation, iteration, and scaling lifecycle programs. 

 Benefits: 
 
 Competitive compensation package, including equity. 
 Inclusive Healthcare Package. 
 Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills. 
 Flexible Time Off. 
 We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed. 
 
 The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $176,000 - $220,000. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.  
 Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description.

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager
jobs.location: Palo Alto, CA; New York, NY
jobs.excerpt:
SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge.  Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates. ABOUT THE ROLE: 
 We are seeking a meticulous and highly organized Growth Marketing Manager to own the backend execution of our marketing programs with precision and reliability. You will design, implement, and continuously improve scalable processes across email automation- ensuring every campaign, asset, and workflow meets the highest standards even in fast-moving, ambiguous environments. This role demands someone who thrives under pressure, balances shifting priorities with ease, and brings a rigorous, process-driven mindset. 
 RESPONSIBILITIES: 
 
 Build and run the content strategy and editorial calendar for the B2B business: why advertise on X, product education, proof (case studies, benchmarks, creative examples), industry point of view, and launch narratives sales can actually use 
 Own end-to-end email automation strategy and execution, with a strong focus on Eloqua (or equivalent platforms), including campaign builds, segmentation, testing, and deployment 
 Define and execute off-platform strategy - paid social, newsletters, webinars, partner and holding-company programs, communities, and more  
 Plan and ship integrated campaigns that connect off-platform discovery to action (advertiser conversations, creative briefings, RFP inclusion, on-platform spend), working directly with sales, product marketing, insights, and creative 
 Manage CRM integrations and data flows (Salesforce preferred), ensuring clean synchronization between marketing tools and the sales ecosystem 
 Partner closely with, sales, product, and engineering teams to translate campaign needs into reliable, automated workflows 
 Maintain impeccable attention to detail across all operational tasks, documentation, and reporting 
 Thrive in ambiguous, high-pressure situations while delivering consistent, high-quality results on tight timelines 
 
 BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: 
 
 Meticulous attention to detail with a proven track record of delivering error-free work in fast-paced environments 
 Exceptional organizational skills and the ability to balance shifting priorities without dropping the ball 
 Comfort thriving under pressure and operating effectively in ambiguous situations 
 Demonstrated experience developing and strictly adhering to QA processes for marketing campaigns and assets 
 Hands-on experience with email automation platforms; Eloqua experience preferred 
 Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills 
 
 PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: 
 
 Proven experience integrating marketing platforms with CRMs; Salesforce experience preferred 
 Familiarity with NextJS for website development and editing 
 Strong project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple initiatives, timelines, and cross-functional dependencies 
 Familiarity with additional marketing tech stack tools (e.g., analytics platforms, data visualization) 
 Background in marketing operations, campaign execution, or similar roles in a high-growth tech environment 
 
 COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS: 
 $112,000 - $160,000 USD 
 Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at xAI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks. SpaceXAI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our Recruitment Privacy Notice .

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager, Advertising
jobs.excerpt:
ABOUT THE TEAM

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure the responsible and widespread adoption of artificial intelligence. In support of that mission, the Marketing team helps deeply understand customer audiences and market dynamics, influence the development of the right products, build sustainable and customer-aligned monetization models, and drive awareness, adoption, and usage across OpenAI’s products and platform.

We take a data-driven approach to understand markets, develop monetization strategies, and uncover customer needs that shape product strategy and messaging. We partner closely with Sales, Partnerships, Product, Engineering, Research, Comms, and Design to deliver a cohesive end-to-end customer experience and lead go-to-market efforts for new product launches across channels.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Product Marketing Manager, Advertising to help bring together advertiser insights, market understanding, and product knowledge to inform positioning, support product priorities, and execute go-to-market initiatives that drive adoption and measurable business impact.

You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Partnerships to understand advertiser needs, translate complex AI capabilities into clear customer value, and bring new products and features to market. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong analytical thinking with hands-on execution, can independently drive clearly scoped workstreams, and is eager to grow their strategic ownership in a fast-moving environment.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

 - Contribute to the product and marketing strategy for a defined area of OpenAI’s advertising business in partnership with senior product marketers and cross-functional partners.

 - Build an understanding of advertisers through customer research, market analysis, and competitive insights, identifying opportunities to improve positioning, adoption, and the customer experience.

 - Develop and maintain positioning and messaging for assigned products or features, translating complex capabilities into clear narratives for different advertiser audiences and use cases.

 - Partner with Product and Engineering to synthesize advertiser feedback and market insights that inform roadmap discussions and product decisions.

 - Execute go-to-market plans for new products and features, independently owning defined workstreams from planning through launch and post-launch adoption.

 - Create advertiser-facing content and sales enablement materials, including product narratives, sales decks, one-pagers, FAQs, case studies, and launch communications.

 - Partner with Sales, Partnerships, Data Science, and Analytics to track success metrics, assess launch and adoption performance, and recommend improvements.

 - Identify advertiser concerns and launch risks related to performance, safety, policy, and trust, escalating them appropriately and incorporating guidance into customer communications.

 - Coordinate cross-functional partners around deliverables, responsibilities, and timelines, proactively surfacing dependencies and resolving blockers within the scope of your initiatives.

 - Contribute to repeatable approaches for launches, messaging, and enablement by documenting learnings, developing templates, and sharing effective practices with the broader team.

YOU MIGHT BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU…

 - Have experience contributing to product marketing strategies and bringing products, features, or programs to market, ideally in advertising, marketing technology, platforms, data, or AI.

 - Have experience applying structured problem-solving approaches in product marketing, strategy or management consulting, investment banking, corporate strategy, venture capital, or a similarly analytical environment.

 - Have familiarity with advertiser goals and the advertising ecosystem, including areas such as measurement, targeting and relevance, creative, auctions, and performance.

 - Can synthesize customer research and market insights into clear positioning, actionable recommendations, and well-executed go-to-market programs.

 - Communicate clearly and persuasively, translating technical concepts into accessible customer value for different audiences.

 - Are comfortable using qualitative and quantitative evidence—including customer interviews, surveys, adoption data, and experiments—to support decisions and improve results.

 - Bring structure and sound judgment to ambiguous problems, independently managing scoped initiatives while seeking input when priorities or tradeoffs are unclear.

 - Build productive working relationships across Product, Engineering, Sales, Partnerships, and other teams, contributing to alignment without relying on formal authority.

 - Are highly organized, attentive to detail, and comfortable managing multiple workstreams in a fast-moving environment.

 - Enjoy learning from others, sharing insights, and helping improve how the team approaches launches, storytelling, and execution.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. 

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form https://form.asana.com/?d=57018692298241&k=5MqR40fZd7jlxVUh5J-UeA. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link https://form.asana.com/?k=bQ7w9h3iexRlicUdWRiwvg&d=57018692298241.

OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy https://cdn.openai.com/policies/global-employee-and-contractor-privacy-policy.pdf

At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

jobs.title: Product Manager - GTM
jobs.excerpt:
At Podium, we bring AI Employees to local businesses that turn every conversation into revenue. Trusted by 60,000+ businesses across Auto, Home Services, and Aesthetics, Podium captures and converts leads 24/7, driving both new business and repeat customers. 
 In under 24 months, we crossed $100M in AI Agent ARR, scaling 300% year-over-year. During this time, we’ve deployed 10,000 AI employees to empower real business outcomes for our customers. Podium is building what we believe will be the most impactful AI employee ecosystem for local business. 
 Podium has been recognized as the Best AI Implementation by Inc. Magazine, highlighted by OpenAI for building revenue-driving AI Agents, and awarded the #1 AI Agent for Business Operations by G2. 
 Our growth is fueled by hiring exceptional people, holding them to high standards, and creating opportunities for them to grow and make an impact. Our operating principles guide daily behavior and ensure we hire people who will thrive at Podium. If you're hungry for growth, aligned to our operating principles, and ready to get to work, you won't find a better place to learn and accelerate your career. About this opportunity: 
 As a Product Manager on the Internal Tools Team, you will define and build the systems, platforms, and automation that power how our GTM teams operate and engage with customers. Your work will directly impact sales performance, customer retention, and operational efficiency across the business. 
 This role is both strategic and execution-focused: you will own the vision, roadmap, and outcomes of internal products that enable teams to execute on company-wide strategy at scale. 
 What you will be doing: 
 
 Product Vision and Roadmap: Define and drive the vision and roadmap for internal platforms and automation that elevate team performance, streamline workflows, and enable more effective customer engagement. 
 AI and Automation Integration: Identify and implement opportunities to apply AI and automation within internal workflows, reducing manual effort, improving decision-making, and increasing the quality and consistency of customer interactions. 
 Zero to One Product Development and Ownership: Lead the end-to-end development of new internal products, platforms, and systems, from concept through launch. Own the adoption, performance, and measurable impact on key business outcomes. 
 Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with Customer Success, Onboarding, Support, Finance, and Legal teams to identify needs, define requirements, and ensure successful rollout and adoption of internal tools. Act as a product evangelist internally and externally, ensuring buy-in across the organization. 
 Customer Insights and Feedback: Engage directly with internal users to gather feedback and insights that will drive product improvements and future innovations. 
 Data-Driven Decisions: Leverage product, usage, and other business performance data to inform decisions and maximize impact. Continuously analyze product metrics and user behavior to uncover new opportunities for growth. 
 Executive Communication: Communicate effectively with executive leadership, demonstrating strong executive presence and the ability to influence strategic decisions through clear and compelling product insights and recommendations. 
 
 What you should have: 
 
 4+ years of product management experience with a track record of successfully delivering web-based products, ideally in SaaS or communication tools. 
 High agency and ownership, with a willingness to tackle problems end-to-end, learning what’s necessary along the way to ensure successful outcomes. 
 Enthusiasm for AI, with a solid understanding of AI systems, including autonomous agents and their practical applications. 
 Proven experience in fast-paced technical environments, adept at working with cross-functional teams to drive product vision, define requirements, and guide projects through key milestones. 
 Demonstrated ability to manage the entire product lifecycle, from concept to launch, and continuously optimize for growth and customer success. 
 Strong collaboration skills, with a proven ability to work cross-functionally with engineering, design, AI, and marketing teams to deliver high-impact products. 
 Strong analytical skills, with hands-on experience in SQL and data visualization tools to drive data-informed product decisions and measure success. 
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate product strategies, updates, and insights to a wide range of audiences, including executive leadership. 
 Experience leading the development of new products from scratch, with a strong bias toward action and execution in dynamic, fast-moving environments. 
 A passion for driving customer engagement and helping local businesses succeed through innovative tools and experiences. 
 
 What we hope you have: 
 
 You are a first principles thinker who isn't just building features but solving problems 
 The desire to move at a breakneck pace 
 A refusal to accept previous norms knowing what is now possible with the use of AI 
 
 Why you’ll love working here: 
 
 You’ll own a high-impact product area with real autonomy: the roadmap, strategy, and day-to-day direction for Podium’s marketing tooling ecosystem. 
 You’ll work on meaningful problems at the intersection of AI, internal tools, and marketing, with the chance to bring structure and innovation to a space that needs clear ownership. 
 You’ll collaborate closely with highly engaged stakeholders across marketing and operations, and play a central role in improving how teams work internally. 
 
 Benefits 
 
 Open and transparent culture 
 Life insurance, long and short-term disability coverage 
 Paid maternity and paternity leave 
 Fertility Benefits 
 Generous vacation time, plus three 4-day summer holiday weekends 
 Excellent medical, dental, and vision benefits 
 401k Plan 
 Bi-annual swag drops with cool Podium gear and apparel 
 A stellar HQ (Utah) gym with local professional coaches and classes offered 
 Onsite HQ (Utah) child care center, subsidized for employees
