We offer an exceptional office-centric culture while adopting the best elements of hybrid models to ensure that every one of our global team members can work together effortlessly. With 13+ offices all over the world, we are always looking for individuals who care about building technology that drives positive change in the world and a culture where everyone feels that they belong. 
 We believe in supporting people to do their best work and thrive. jobs.title: Regional Revenue Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt:
The Regional Revenue Marketing Manager will help drive account expansion and deal acceleration through integrated regional marketing programs, with Sales as a primary stakeholder. As a key marketing partner for assigned AMER markets, you’ll collaborate with sales and marketing to build and execute programs that engage decision makers, advance buying committees, accelerate the sales cycle, and improve conversion to customers. You’ll experiment with new approaches and tools while applying a disciplined, analytical approach to measuring program performance and business impact. You are a data-guided, results-driven marketer and collaborative partner to cross-functional stakeholders. 
 We're looking to speak with candidates based in Chicago or Minneapolis for our hybrid working model. 
 Position Expectations 
 
 Contribute to and execute the field marketing plan for assigned AMER markets, in partnership with regional marketing leadership and Sales. The integrated plan may include digital programs, web and webinars, trade shows, regional events, pipeline acceleration events, and the annual roadshow, in concert with key customers and partners in the region 
 Build and execute decision-maker programs that engage executives, business leaders, technical leaders, and other influential personas across strategic accounts 
 Partner with account teams to understand account priorities, buying committees, decision-making processes, whitespace opportunities, and barriers to expansion; translate those insights into relevant programs and experiences 
 Develop and coordinate account-focused programs that support enterprise opportunities, strengthen relationships with key decision makers, and help create momentum through the sales cycle 
 Work with the wider organization to support strategies that expand usage of MongoDB across enterprise accounts and across personas, from developers to C-level executives 
 Support developer groundswell initiatives within assigned markets and contribute to tracking and reporting on developers enabled in the region 
 Generate programs that contribute to pipeline, account expansion, and net annual recurring revenue (NARR), and track and report on results 
 Be a trusted partner to regional Sales leadership and account teams by understanding territory needs and executing marketing strategies and programs that support deal velocity 
 Conduct market and account research to identify regional opportunities, relevant audiences, and effective engagement strategies 
 Work closely with regional marketing managers and cross-functional partners across AMER to align plans with Sales and Marketing goals and objectives 
 Ensure program performance, pipeline influence, and ROI are tracked consistently; use insights to optimize programs and improve outcomes 
 Support flagship events, sponsored conferences, regional events, and customer or executive experiences 
 Manage budgets for assigned programs and markets, ensuring thoughtful allocation and accurate tracking of spend and results 
 
 Requirements 
 
 Bachelor’s degree and/or 3–6 years of regional, field, revenue, account-based, or customer marketing experience in an enterprise software, B2B SaaS, or technology company 
 Experience developing programs for executive audiences, buying committees, or other enterprise decision makers; experience with account-based and/or developer marketing is a plus 
 Highly results-driven with strong analytical ability and a metrics-oriented approach to success. Able to track outcomes and demonstrate ROI for funded and co-marketing activities against budget 
 Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Account Management, Customer Success, or partner teams 
 Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to tailor messaging and programs to different audiences 
 Experience with CRM and marketing automation systems, such as Salesforce, Eloqua, Jira, or similar platforms 
 Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment 
 Good humor and a positive, can-do attitude 
 30–50% travel to assigned markets 
 
 About MongoDB 
 MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. 
 With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software. 
 Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.  
 To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy , we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB , and help us make an impact on the world! 
 MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter. 
 MongoDB, Inc. provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type and makes all hiring decisions without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Compensation at the time of offer is unique to each candidate and based on a variety of factors such as skill set, experience, qualifications, and work location. Salary is one part of MongoDB’s total compensation and benefits package. Other benefits for eligible employees may include: equity, participation in the employee stock purchase program, flexible paid time off, 20 weeks fully-paid gender-neutral parental leave, fertility and adoption assistance, 401(k) plan, mental health counseling, access to transgender-inclusive health insurance coverage, and health benefits offerings. Please note, the base salary range listed below and the benefits in this paragraph are only applicable to U.S.-based candidates. jobs.title: Content Marketing Specialist
jobs.excerpt:
Overview

We are seeking a full-time Content Marketing Specialist at Garmin's U.S. headquarters in the Greater Kansas City area. In this role, you will be responsible for demonstrating creativity in your portfolio and a proven ability to write for traditional media outlets and digital mediums. This role also must have the ability to operate independently to contribute to the Garmin.com blog by generating original ideas and completing stories to help readers understand Garmin products, features, and marketing stories in alignment with Garmin business objectives. In addition, this position must be comfortable discussing and developing big-picture content strategy and able to digest complex information, transforming it into easy-to-understand articles or long-form content for readers with required attention to detail and the ability to work under deadlines .

Essential Functions
• Develop original and creative concepts for blog posts designed to attract new and existing Garmin customers
• Independently oversee a story idea from conception to publication, including initial research, producing creative copy, and guiding it through the editing and approval process to build for publication while collaborating with other departments to ensure promotion and maximum readership
• Utilize a thorough understanding of Garmin’s business segments and marketing objectives to determine without management direction which topics are chosen for coverage to attract readership
• Analyze and develop a plan to optimize content for maximum performance on search engines like Google
• Act as a Garmin “reporter” conducting interviews with both internal and external parties, following through on “leads,” and developing stories that adhere to Associate Press (AP) style
• Manage the library of content currently existing on the Garmin.com blog to ensure accuracy, timeliness, relevance, and updated marketing objectives as well as exercise independent judgment to analyze and assess content, develop a plan of action, and then edit and remove content as appropriate
• Collaborate with other departments to recommend, develop, and execute integrated content campaigns inclusive of blog, PR, social and eblast as assigned
• Independently manage multiple time sensitive projects simultaneously, using discretion to establish priorities and triage urgent matters
• Complete other Garmin.com duties as assigned by the Content Marketing Manager

Basic Qualifications
• Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Journalism, or related field AND a minimum of 2 years of demonstrated professional experience as a journalist, communications strategist, marketing specialist, writer, or content curator
• Must be detail-oriented and have the ability to work proactively and effectively with minimal supervision
• Demonstrated aptitude and experience writing and editing both long and short form content
• Demonstrated understanding of content marketing strategy and implementation
• Proven ability to work on deadlines
• Experience optimizing content, taking GEO/SEO and Google Analytics into consideration
• Strong passion for Garmin business and products
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Sprinklr, WordPress or other content management software
• Understanding of web publishing requirements
• Must possess demonstrated editorial mindset with an ability to predict audience preferences
• Must possess excellent communication and writing skills in the English language

Desired Qualifications
• Owner of previous published writing samples

Garmin International is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, citizenship, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran's status, age or disability.

This position is eligible for Garmin's benefit program. Details can be found here: Garmin Benefits

jobs.excerpt:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. 
 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. 
 * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. An overview of this role 
 As an Associate Revenue Operations Analyst, Policy & Rules of Engagement, you will help the Field Sales team apply go-to-market policies consistently. You will learn to support requests and policy-related disputes, maintain documentation and data, and help make processes easier to understand and use. This is an entry-level, remote role aligned to time zones in the United States. 
 What you’ll do 
 
 Support the documentation and maintenance of go-to-market policies and rules of engagement for the Field Sales team. 
 Respond to policy questions and support the resolution of policy-related disputes through Salesforce Chatter, case requests, and the Sales Support Slack channel. 
 Apply established policies carefully and identify questions that need escalation. 
 Maintain accurate data, process documentation, and best practices for first-tier sales teams. 
 Work with operations, strategy, sales compensation, and sales systems partners to support consistent processes. 
 Identify documentation or process gaps and share them with the appropriate team members. 
 Support policy updates and annual planning activities as business needs change. 
 
 What you’ll bring 
 
 Interest in revenue or sales operations, policies, and the systems that support go-to-market teams. 
 Experience working carefully with data, documentation, or administrative processes through coursework, internships, projects, or previous roles. 
 Ability to review information closely, identify issues, and document clear next steps. 
 Ability to organize multiple requests, prioritize work, and meet deadlines. 
 Clear written and verbal communication skills for working with stakeholders across teams. 
 Interest in supporting policy application and resolving questions or disputes fairly and consistently. 
 Demonstrated curiosity by asking questions, learning new processes, and taking ownership of assigned work. 
 Salesforce administration experience or familiarity with Salesforce is a plus. 
 
 About the team 
 The Revenue Operations team supports go-to-market teams by building and maintaining the processes, policies, and systems they use to serve customers. We work asynchronously with partners across GitLab to make rules of engagement clear, consistent, and scalable as business needs evolve. 
 The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity . Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.  Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being

 Team Member Resource Groups

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
jobs.excerpt:
Who We Are 
 At Justworks, you’ll enjoy a welcoming and casual environment, great benefits, wellness program offerings, company retreats, and the ability to interact with and learn from leaders in the startup community. We work hard and care about our most prized asset - our people. 
 We’re helping businesses get off the ground by enabling them to focus on running their business. We solve HR issues. We’re data-driven and never stop iterating. If you’d like to work in a supportive, entrepreneurial environment, are interested in building something meaningful and having fun while doing it, we’d love to hear from you. 
 We're united by shared goals and shared motivations at Justworks. These are best summed up in our company values, which are reflected in our product and in our team. 
 Our Values 
 If this sounds like you, you’ll fit right in. Who You Are 
 You’re proactive, ambitious, and energized by solving problems and creating opportunities. You’re curious about how businesses operate, enjoy connecting with people, and communicate clearly and confidently. You stay organized, learn quickly, and bring a strong work ethic and positive attitude to everything you do. 
 This role is a strong foundation for a long-term career across sales, customer success, marketing, revenue operations, and broader go-to-market leadership. This role has a clear path to internal mobility with many of our top performers going on to grow into other roles across the business. 
 At Justworks, we’re building a modern pipeline generation engine that combines thoughtful human engagement with smarter tools, better signals, and more efficient workflows. We’re looking for people who are curious, adaptable, productive, highly motivated, and excited to grow alongside the evolution of modern go-to-market teams. 
 What You’ll Work On 
 As a Sales Development Representative (SDR) at Justworks, you’ll play a key role in growing our outbound pipeline and generating new business opportunities. This role will spend about 70% of your day contacting, prospecting, and researching potential customers. 
 You will: 
 
 Own outbound prospecting and pipeline generation within your assigned territory or segment 
 Research and identify prospective customers using a combination of data, tools, and market signals 
 Execute outbound outreach across phone, email, LinkedIn, and other channels to engage decision-makers 
 Generate qualified sales conversations and build pipeline for Account Executives 
 Learn and effectively use modern sales tools and workflows to improve productivity and outreach quality 
 Conduct thoughtful, value-driven conversations focused on understanding customer needs 
 Develop expertise in Justworks, our product suite, and the broader HR/PEO landscape 
 Continuously refine your messaging, prospecting approach, and workflow efficiency 
 
 Your Success Profile 
 We’re looking for individuals who embody our core values and demonstrate curiosity, ownership, adaptability, coachability, collaboration, and a strong customer mindset. 
 Successful SDRs at Justworks tend to be: 
 Results-Oriented You’re motivated by goals, accountable for outcomes, and willing to put in the work to improve and succeed. 
 Curious & Adaptable You learn quickly, ask thoughtful questions, and are open to evolving your approach as tools, workflows, and customer expectations change. 
 Operationally Minded You stay organized, manage your time well, and look for ways to work smarter and more efficiently. 
 Strong Communicators You can simplify complex topics, communicate clearly, and build trust quickly through thoughtful, customer-focused conversations. 
 Customer-First You approach outreach with curiosity, empathy, and a consultative mindset. You care about creating a positive experience for prospects and understand that strong customer relationships start long before a sale is closed. 
 Coachable You actively seek feedback, apply it quickly, and continuously look for ways to improve. You view coaching as an opportunity for growth and are committed to developing your skills over time. 
 Collaborative You recognize that great outcomes are a team effort. You build strong relationships with teammates and cross-functional partners, share best practices, celebrate team success, and contribute positively to the culture around you. 
 Resilient You handle rejection well, stay positive, and maintain consistency in a fast-paced outbound environment. 
 Our Core Values (COGIS) 
 Camaraderie You enjoy working toward shared goals, support your teammates, and treat others with respect. 
 Openness You are curious, receptive to feedback, and willing to consider new ideas and perspectives. 
 Grit You persevere through challenges with commitment and a positive attitude. 
 Integrity You follow through on commitments, communicate honestly, and lead by example. 
 Simplicity You value clarity, efficiency, and straightforward solutions. 
 Qualifications 
 
 Must be available to work Monday-Friday from either 9am-6pm or 10am-7pm ET, with Tuesdays and Thursdays as the team's onsite days at our office at 55 Water Street, in New York City ( required ) 
 Strong interest in sales, business development, and outbound pipeline generation 
 Comfortable with outbound outreach across phone, email, LinkedIn, and other channels 
 Comfortable being on the phone for 70% of your day and researching potential prospects  
 Strong written and verbal communication skills 
 Ability to research accounts, identify relevant prospects, and understand customer needs 
 Highly organized with strong time management skills 
 Fast learner with a growth mindset and willingness to adopt new tools and processes 
 
 Preferred Experience 
 
 Experience using sales and prospecting tools such as Salesforce, Gong Engage, Default, , Orum, Nooks, Amplemarket, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar platforms 
 Exposure to AI tools or AI-assisted workflows used to improve prospecting, research, messaging, or productivity 
 Customer-facing or high-volume outreach experience is a plus 
 
 Compensation 
 This position is paid a base wage plus incentive compensation. The base wage range for this position is targeted at $29.81-$35.10 in our New York City office, and competitive On-Target Earnings, inclusive of incentive compensation, of *$88,600.00-$104,300.00. Final offers may vary from those listed. *Incentive compensation is not guaranteed, and earning is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive compensation plan. 
 This role is required to work Monday-Friday from either 9am-6pm or 10am-7pm ET, with Tuesdays and Thursdays as the team's onsite days at our office at 55 Water Street, in New York City.

These tools support, but do not replace, human review. Depending on where you reside, you may have rights regarding our use of automated tools. For more information, please contact us at privacy@justworks.com.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative, Strategic Accounts
jobs.excerpt:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency — slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you've built. The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year. If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

What You'll Do

 - Help build the strategic account motion at Ramp — sourcing deals, bridging introductions, and progressing sales opportunities in the pipeline.

 - Own a named book of Strategic Enterprise accounts (5,000+ employees), building durable coverage and pipeline across a smaller, higher-value set.

 - Develop account plans with your AE: prioritize accounts, map the buying group, identify the "why now," and align on a path to engagement.

 - Research and engage finance leaders through personalized, multi-channel outreach; qualify prospects through consultative discovery.

 - Coordinate with AEs, Marketing, Partnerships, and Events to use warm introductions, executive programs, and customer stories effectively.

 - Use AI tools thoughtfully to strengthen research, prioritization, and personalization — validating outputs before using them.

 - Maintain accurate prospect and activity data in Salesforce; use performance data to improve outreach quality.

What You'll Need

 - Proven SDR/BDR, closing, or equivalent quota-carrying experience, with measurable evidence of attainment or overachievement.

 - Experience working a named-account or account-based motion — prioritizing accounts and tailoring outreach to senior or complex buyers.

 - Proven ability to partner with Account Executives on account strategy, meeting prep, and deal progression.

 - Strong discovery, objection-handling, and written/verbal communication skills.

 - A builder mindset: diagnose results, form a point of view, adapt, and turn what works into repeatable practice.

 - Ability to operate independently in an evolving motion — creating structure, managing ambiguity, and raising issues early.

 - Interest in building a long-term sales career and taking on the scope of a Strategic SDR role.

Nice to Haves

 - Experience selling into large, complex, or enterprise organizations with multiple stakeholders and longer buying cycles.

 - Experience selling into finance, accounting, or operations teams, or familiarity with finance workflows (expense, AP, procurement, ERPs).

 - Familiarity with Salesforce, sales engagement platforms, or account research/intent tools.

 - Prior experience scaling a new team or motion, or working with partner ecosystems and field events.

BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

 - Flexible PTO

 - Centralized home-office equipment ordering

 - Health and wellness stipend

 - Budget for intra-office travel

 - Weekly coffee stipend

UNITED STATES

 - 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

 - One Medical annual membership

jobs.title: Event Specialist, Marketing
jobs.excerpt:
About Formlabs: 
 Do you want to change how the world creates? 
 At Formlabs, we’re building the tools that make it possible for anyone to bring their ideas to life, from cutting-edge products to life-saving medical devices. Our 3D printing technology powers innovation at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA. Together, we’re helping everyone design, prototype, and manufacture faster than ever before. 
 We’re a team of hands-on builders, engineers, and innovators reinventing how the world makes physical things. If you’re ready to shape the future of fabrication, come build it with us. 
 Your Impact:  
 Trade shows and events are where Formlabs puts our products directly in front of the people who use them, and North America is one of our most active regions on the calendar. As Event Specialist, you'll be the right hand to our NA Events Managers - involved in every show from planning to final wrap-up, and building the hands-on expertise that experiential marketing careers are built on. 
 You'll own the details that make a booth come together: ordering printed collateral, preparing displays and product samples, keeping consumables stocked, and coordinating the shipping, vendors, and campaign materials behind every show. It's a fast-paced and high-visibility role.  
 What You’ll Do: 
 
 Act as the right hand to the Marketing Managers, Events (NA), involved in the planning and execution of every trade show and company event on the North America calendar 
 Order and manage printed collateral (leaflets, brochures, signage), ensuring materials are on-brand, accurate, and delivered on time 
 Prepare, track, and pack display parts, demo units, and product samples for each show, making sure the right materials are ready to ship 
 Order and manage booth consumables and supplies (e.g., cleaning and setup supplies, packaging, printer/label materials) needed for smooth onsite execution 
 Track and maintain inventory of event materials, including demo units, signage, swag, 3D-printed demo parts, and booth hardware 
 Coordinate with recurring vendors and shipping/freight partners to ensure materials arrive on time and within budget 
 Maintain internal tools such as shipping calendars, logistics trackers, and asset management systems 
 Support post-show wrap-up: processing returns, documenting damage, and assisting with invoice reconciliation 
 Support execution of pre- and post-event marketing campaigns (email, social, promotional materials) in partnership with the Marketing Manager, Events 
 Help prepare internal enablement materials for booth staff, such as demo scripts, presentation decks, and talking points 
 Support onsite booth staffing coordination and scheduling 
 Assist with gathering event performance data (leads, attendance, engagement) and compiling post-event reports 
 Coordinate with the design team to ensure booth assets, signage, and collateral are on-brand and print-ready 
 Serve as onsite support at events, helping represent Formlabs to customers, partners, and prospects 
 Up to 25% travel across North America,  to assist with onsite event marketing tasks. 
 
 About You: 
 
 1–3 years of experience in events, marketing, or logistics coordination - through professional experience, internships, academic projects, or other hands-on involvement 
 Strong organizational and project management skills; comfortable managing multiple timelines and shifting priorities 
 Familiarity with event marketing fundamentals (campaigns, collateral, brand guidelines) and/or event logistics (freight, vendors, booth operations) 
 A proactive communicator who works well cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Design, and Logistics 
 A detail-oriented, get-it-done attitude, with comfort working independently on defined projects and asking for guidance on new or ambiguous problems 
 Comfortable traveling ~25% of the time 
 
 Bonus Skills:  
 
 Experience creating or supporting event marketing content (email, social, presentations) 
 Background in B2B tech or manufacturing 
 Familiarity with international shipping, customs paperwork, or exhibit house coordination 
 
 Our Benefits & Perks: 
 
 Robust equity program to build future wealth through RSUs 
 Comprehensive healthcare coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision) 
 401K matching and access to financial advisors 
 Generous paid Parental Leave (up to 16 weeks) 
 Tenure-based paid Sabbatical Leave (up to 6 weeks) 
 Flexible Out of Office Plan – Take time when you need it 
 Ample on-site parking & pre-tax commuter benefits 
 Healthy on-site lunches, snacks, beverages, & treats 
 Regular sponsored professional development opportunities 
 Many opt-in culture events across our diverse community 
 And of course… unlimited 3D prints 
 
 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company.  We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.   
 Even if you don't check every box, but see yourself contributing, please apply. Help us build an inclusive community that will change the face of 3D printing. 
 Our Candidate AI Guidelines are available here . Please give them a read. Compensation 
 We are all owners of Formlabs and direct beneficiaries of our success. We believe that equity is a critical component of compensation at Formlabs, and we want our newest team members to understand the potential value of their equity compensation. Full time employees receive equity, in the form of RSUs. Your financial investment will grow with us in accordance to your impact. 
 At Formlabs, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. Your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, location and expected impact on the organization. The annual base pay range for this role is: $75,000 — $95,000 USD

jobs.title: Outbound Sales Development Representative (Pipeline)
jobs.location: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
jobs.excerpt:
Why join us 
 Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek. 
 Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career. Sales at Brex 
 Sales is the growth engine at Brex. We bring in new customers, expand existing relationships, and drive the company’s bottom line. With unlimited territories and uncapped opportunity, your ambition sets the ceiling. We win together, celebrate often, and reward performance. If you want to sell a category-defining product with real ownership, this is your team. 
 What you’ll do 
 As a Sales Development Representative, you will be responsible for prospecting and identifying new customers for Brex. You will partner with Account Executives to help businesses understand the value of Brex as a financial services solution and the rewards that it provides fast growing companies. We’re rapidly growing our team which requires a “whatever it takes” attitude, a high sense of urgency, and a passion for sales. As an SDR at Brex, you will have the opportunity to help create processes and build pipelines for $1 million deals immediately.  
 Where you’ll work This role will be based in our Salt Lake City office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require three days per week in office - Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work! 
 Responsibilities 
 
 Identify growing companies that would gain value from Brex  
 Prospect companies that are growing and spending; educate them on our modern corporate card and spend management software 
 Navigate through a conversation flow to uncover business needs, understand pains, and position Brex as a compelling solution 
 Maintain and update an accurate log of activity in the CRM system 
 Hit daily KPIs across a variety of touch points: email, phone, social 
 Use email to correspond with leads to follow up and/or to confirm appointments 
 Provide feedback to others in department related to information prospects share that could be helpful in advertising/marketing as well as our overall programs 
 
 Requirements 
 
 Experience in a general sales role OR a related field in hospitality, customer service, etc. 
 The ability to proactively engage new clients through email and phone 
 A high sense of urgency coupled with an ability to adapt and pivot in every conversation 
 Strong communication skills to passionately and clearly articulate the value of Brex 
 Work with Marketing Operations to define, execute, and optimize prospecting approaches through A/B tests 
 A team-player attitude with a desire to improve internal processes beyond your day-to-day tasks 
 A desire to learn, grow, and launch your career at a cutting-edge financial technology company  
 
 Bonus points 
 
 SaaS or B2B experience  
 Experience with Salesforce, Outreach, and/or ZoomInfo 
 Demonstrated ability to exceed impact & activity quotas  
 
 Compensation 
 The expected OTE range for this role is $73,040 - $82,852 USD. The starting wage will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. This OTE range reflects a standard work week, however, as an hourly employee if you exceed these hours, you will be paid overtime. The OTE figure listed here includes base compensation and commissions, which may or may not be earned depending on performance.  Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation. Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a  brex.com  domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

jobs.excerpt:
About Hightouch 
 Hightouch is an Agentic Marketing Platform powered by the industry-leading Composable CDP. With complete brand context, customer data, and performance history in one place, every marketer finally has the power to build and ship end-to-end campaigns themselves. Teams move faster, stay on brand, and get AI marketing that actually works. 
 Founded in 2019 and headquartered in San Francisco, Hightouch enables marketing teams to analyze performance, brainstorm ideas, and generate creative at a speed and quality that wasn't previously possible. 
 Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Customer Data Platforms, Hightouch is trusted by leading enterprises like Domino's, Spotify, Aritzia, Cars.com, Ramp, and PetSmart. 
 At Hightouch, our mission is to help our customers leverage data and AI to grow their businesses. The team is ambitious, impact-driven, efficient — and we believe humility, kindness, and compassion are essential to our success. If you're energized by velocity, obsessed with raising the bar, and want to build alongside people who care deeply about each other and our customers, we'd love to meet you. About The Role  
 Hightouch is looking for a Sales Development Representative to join our founding Ad-Studio team to help build the outbound motion for Hightouch's creative platform for building, editing, and launching on-brand ads at the volume performance marketing requires. You'll be a key player in helping stand up a brand-new product motion; there's no established playbook here, so you'll be working directly with leadership to build the foundational processes, messaging, and strategies as we go. You will be outbounding to performance marketers, creative and brand teams, so we are looking for someone who is highly intelligent, comfortable with ambiguity, and able to connect with multiple audiences. 
 What You’ll Do  
 
 Outreach directly into prospective customers who fit our ideal persona (performance marketing, growth, creative, and marketing ops leaders) via cold calls, text, emails, integrated marketing campaigns, LinkedIn campaigns, and other methods 
 Work with the growth team to research and craft personalized outreach to target accounts, tying messaging to real creative and campaign pain points (creative fatigue, slow production cycles, brand consistency at scale) 
 Find creative methods, channels, and strategies to help guide prospects to a Hightouch Ad Studio demo 
 Own building the outbound playbook from the ground up, you will help shape process, messaging, tooling, and strategy for this new product rather than inherit them 
 You will be tasked with a goal and expected to execute against it on a monthly basis 
 
 What We're Looking For 
 
 Bachelor's degree 
 Self-starter, ability to self-motivate and build from zero in a high-growth start-up 
 Comfort operating without an established playbook and helping create one 
 Effective communication skills, both written and verbal 
 Prior experience (1+ years) engaging customers and prospects 
 Interest in tech, and ideally in marketing, advertising, or data 
 Ability to multitask, organize, and prioritize work 
 
 Even if your experience does not line up perfectly, we are still excited to have you apply. The best hires do not always check off every box of a job description. 
 
 Compensation Details 
 On-Target Earnings: $100,000 annually Base Salary: $70,000 annually OTE is one component of Hightouch's competitive total rewards package and is location independent in accordance with our remote-first policy. We also offer meaningful equity compensation. 

 E-Verify Statement 
 Hightouch participates in E-Verify. After you join the team, we'll verify your eligibility to work in the U.S. by submitting information from your Form I-9 to the Social Security Administration and, if needed, the Department of Homeland Security. This process happens post-hire only — we never use E-Verify to pre-screen applicants.

 Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company. We free people and agents to ship what’s next. 
 For more than a decade, Vercel has shaped how the web is built. As the team behind Next.js, v0, and AI SDK, we create products that help builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience. 
 Now, software is entering a new era, and the next generation of products will not just be used by people. They will be built, extended, and operated by agents. 
 We are building the platform for that future, trusted by companies like  OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide . Whether you’re building our products, supporting our customers, growing our community, or shaping our story, you’ll help define what comes next. About the Role: 
 Vercel is seeking a Business Development Representative to help bring the next wave of innovative companies onto the Vercel platform. This role is ideal for individuals who are curious about web technologies and eager to launch their career in technical sales at one of the world’s leading developer tools companies. 
 As a Business Development Representative, you’ll play a key role in connecting with engineering and product leaders at fast-growing companies, educating them on how Vercel can help their teams ship faster and build better web experiences. You’ll work closely with Account Executives to identify, qualify, and nurture opportunities within the Majors segment — our largest enterprise customers. 
 This is a hands-on, high-impact role where you’ll learn directly from world-class sales and product leaders, gain exposure to the SaaS sales cycle, and build a strong foundation for a career in go-to-market at Vercel. 
 What You Will Do: 
 
 Identify and engage enterprise companies that could benefit from Vercel’s platform 
 Research prospects and tailor outreach to engineering and product leaders 
 Qualify inbound leads and generate outbound opportunities through personalized outreach 
 Partner with Account Executives to build pipeline and drive adoption in the Majors segment 
 Collaborate cross-functionally with Marketing, Sales Engineering, and Customer Success to refine messaging and improve outreach effectiveness 
 
 About You: 
 
 Passion for web development and staying current with the latest trends and technologies 
 2+ years of experience as an outbound SDR 
 Ability to navigate and prospect into large org structures in the Fortune 500 
 Excellent communication skills — ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders 
 Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail 
 Self-motivated and able to work independently while also collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams 
 
 Bonus If You Have Experience With: 
 
 Background in computer science, web development, or a related technical field 
 Vercel, Next.js, or any other technical background or understanding 
 Salesforce, Outreach, or similar 
 
 Benefits: 
 
 Competitive compensation package, including equity. 
 Inclusive Healthcare Package. 
 Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills. 
 Flexible Time Off. 
 We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed. 
 
 The San Francisco, CA OTE pay range for this role is $100,000 - $120,000 OTE. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.  
 Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative (BDR)
jobs.excerpt:
ABOUT US:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

THE ROLE

We're looking for motivated and tech-savvy Business Development Representatives (BDRs) with a strong interest in AI to join our growing sales team. In this role, you’ll play a key part in building a healthy pipeline for our Account Executives by qualifying inbound leads and proactively prospecting into high-value target accounts. This is an opportunity to be at the frontlines of a fast-moving AI company, engaging in thoughtful, technical conversations with a knowledgeable customer base.

The ideal candidate is results driven, exhibits strong intellectual curiosity of the evolving AI space, and can operate in a fast-paced, highly-dynamic start up environment. You should be comfortable initiating outreach, handling nuanced product discussions, and helping prospects understand the impact of generative AI on their business.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Strategically prospect into key accounts across email, calling and Linkedin, communicating Fireworks AI’s unique value proposition

 - Consistently meet new business opportunity and pipeline generation targets

 - Craft personalized, tailored outreach through various research methods to prioritize the right accounts and prospects

 - Qualify and engage inbound leads, ensuring a smooth transition to our Account Executive team

 - Act as a brand ambassador, educating prospects on the power and potential of our inference solutions

 - Collaborate with Sales and Marketing to refine messaging and outreach strategies based on market feedback

 - Stay current on AI/ML trends to conduct informed, relevant conversations with technical and business audiences

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

 - Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience

 - Demonstrated interest in technology sales, with a strong interest AI and machine learning

 - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; able to engage confidently with technical stakeholders

 - Self-motivated and organized, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Previous startup or entrepreneurial experience, with a proactive and adaptable mindset

 - Prior experience in a customer facing role, ideally in SaaS, AI, or emerging tech

 - Familiarity with CRM systems and sales engagement tools (e.g., Salesforce, Outreach, Apollo, etc.)

 - Degree in engineering, computer science, or a related technical field

 - Active interest in AI/tech communities with a demonstrated commitment to continuous learning in the space

Fireworks AI's goal is to provide competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for candidates in the San Francisco/New York City Area for this role is $85,000 - $100,000 per year.

WHY FIREWORKS?

 - Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving.

 - Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally.

 - Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results.

 - Learn from the Best: Collaborate with world-class engineers and AI researchers who thrive on curiosity and innovation.

Fireworks AI is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all innovators.

jobs.title: GTM Compensation Leader
jobs.location: Chicago | New York City | Salt Lake City | San Francisco
jobs.excerpt:
Gong harnesses the power of AI to transform how revenue teams win. The Gong Revenue AI Operating System unifies data, insights, and workflows into a single, trusted system that observes, guides, and acts alongside the world’s most successful revenue teams. Powered by the Gong Revenue Graph, AI-powered intelligence, specialized agents, and trusted applications, Gong helps more than 5,000 companies around the world deeply understand their teams and customers, automate critical sales workflows, and close more deals with less effort. For more information, visit www.gong.io. 
 At Gong, you will join a company built on innovative products, ambitious goals, and passionate people. We are shaping the future of revenue intelligence and we want people who are excited to build what comes next. You will work with a team that dreams big, moves fast, and cares deeply about the craft and about each other. Here, transparency and trust are core to how we operate, and every person has the opportunity to make a visible impact. If you want to grow, stretch, and do work that truly matters, Gong is the place to do the best work of your career. Overview The GTM Compensation Leader owns the end-to-end strategy, design, and operations of sales compensation across the GTM organization. This role is the connective layer between RevOps, Finance, and Field leadership — translating business strategy into comp plans that drive the right behaviors, scale with the business, and hold up to audit and compliance scrutiny. You will lead a comp team, own the ICM/SPM platform, and be the primary voice on plan design, exception handling, and comp operations. 
 Core Responsibilities 
 Comp Plan Design & Strategy   
 
 Own the design of sales compensation plans across segments (Sales, CS/RA, SDR, Partnership, Solution Engineers and otherwhere applicable) — quota, accelerators, SPIFFs, and plan mechanics. 
 Translate GTM strategy (new logo, expansion, retention, Healthy ARR) into comp incentives that drive the intended rep behavior. 
 Partner with RevOps, GTM Leadership, and Finance to align comp design to business priorities each planning cycle. 
 
 Comp Operations & Exception Handling 
 
 Own end-to-end comp operations: crediting, calculations, payout accuracy, and dispute resolution. 
 Build scalable exception-handling logic and governance so one-off requests don't erode plan integrity. 
 Ensure timely, accurate payout cycles with clear audit trails. 
 
 ICM / SPM Platform Ownership :  
 
 Serve as the business owner for the ICM/SPM tool (e.g., Varicent, Everstage) — configuration, roadmap, and vendor relationship. 
 Lead or oversee implementation, migration, or optimization of the platform as the comp motion scales. 
 Ensure the platform reflects current plan logic with minimal manual workaround. 
 
 Compliance & Finance Partnership 
 
 Partner with Finance/Accounting to ensure comp expense recognition is compliant with ASC 606. 
 Own documentation and controls needed to support audit, SOX, and quarter/year-end close. 
 Ensure comp plan changes are properly evaluated for accounting and compliance impact before rollout. 
 
 Team Leadership 
 
 Lead and develop a sales compensation team; build a scalable operating model as headcount and plan complexity grow. 
 Set the bar for accuracy, responsiveness, and trust between the comp function and the field. 
 
 Change Management & Communication 
 
 Own communication and rollout of plan changes — clear, simple, and well-timed to the field. 
 Build feedback loops with field leadership to catch design issues early. 
 
 Scalable Systems & Governance 
 
 Build governance models (approval flows, exception thresholds, plan documentation standards) that scale without adding headcount. 
 Maintain a single source of truth for plan documents, rates, and quotas. 
 
 Key Qualifications 
 
 Experience leading a sales compensation team within a SaaS/tech environment 
 Hands-on experience implementing and/or owning an ICM or SPM tool — CaptivateIQ, Varicent or Everstage strongly preferred 
 Proven ownership of, and partnership across, comp plan design and comp operations 
 ASC 606 experience (comp expense recognition, accounting partnership) 
 Comfortable operating between strategy (plan design, GTM alignment) and execution (calculations, exceptions, payout accuracy) 
 Strong communication and change management skills — able to explain comp mechanics simply to the field 
 Based in NYC, Salt Lake City, Chicago, or SF 
 
 Perks and Benefits:  
 
 We offer Gongsters a variety of medical, dental, and vision plans, designed to fit you and your family’s needs. 
 Wellbeing Fund - flexible wellness stipend to support a healthy lifestyle. 
 Mental Health benefits with covered therapy and coaching. 
 401(k) program to help you invest in your future. 
 Education & learning stipend for personal growth and development. 
 Flexible vacation time to promote a healthy work-life blend. 
 Paid parental leave to support you and your family. 
 Company-wide recharge days each quarter. 
 Work from home stipend to help you succeed in a remote environment. 
 
 The annual salary hiring range for this position is $138,000 - $210,000 USD.  
 Compensation is based on factors unique to each candidate, including, but not limited to, job-related skills, qualification, education, experience, and location. At Gong, we have a location-based compensation structure, which means there may be a different range for candidates in other locations. The total compensation package for this position, in addition to base compensation, may include incentive compensation, bonus, equity, and benefits. Some of our sales compensation programs also offer the potential to achieve above targeted earnings for those who exceed their sales targets.  
 We are always looking for outstanding Gongsters! So if this sounds like something that interests you regardless of compensation, please reach out. We may have more roles for you to consider and would love to connect. 
 We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Gong recruiting email communications will always come from the @gong.io domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Gong via other sources should be ignored. 
 
 Gong is an equal-opportunity employer. We believe that diversity is integral to our success, and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, military status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. 
 To review Gong's privacy policy, visit https://www.gong.io/gong-io-job-candidates-privacy-notice/ for more details.

Our Mission: 
 6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency.  We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential. 
 Our People: 
 People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging.  Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology.  6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers.  We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.  
 Our Mission:   
 6sense is on a mission to revolutionize how B2B organizations create revenue by predicting customers most likely to buy and recommending the best course of action to engage anonymous buying teams. 6sense Revenue AI is the only sales and marketing platform to unlock the ability to create, manage and convert high-quality pipeline to revenue.   
 Our People: 
 People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Accountability, Growth Mindset, Integrity, Fun and One Team. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology.  6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers.   
 We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.   
 This is a hybrid role located in one of our hubs: Austin, TX, Madison, WI, or New York, NY. 
 
 The Role:  
 We are looking for high-energy, driven professionals with sound business acumen, strong technical aptitude and natural sales instincts to join our Sales organization as a Business Development Representative. Your purpose will be to uncover and qualify new opportunities across our target market.  You'll be measured on your ability to create Opportunities that lead to new business.  Ideal candidates should be eager to advance their career by demonstrating their ability to be tenacious self-starters every day. 
 As a Business Development Representative on the Strategic team at 6sense, you’ll be an instrumental player to our growth as we build upon the success we’ve had delivering predictions for enterprises like Cisco, Lenovo, BlueJeans, and Xactly. We will trust you to evangelize 6sense, open doors into opportunities, and consistently exceed targets.  This is not your average start-up; you’ll be going after large deals. 
 What's in it for You: 
 
 The opportunity to generate new business opportunities to fuel our growth 
 Create and prioritize strategic target account lists within a defined territory 
 Research and build accounts (i.e. adding contacts, sending emails, strategic calling) 
 Conduct high level conversations with senior executives in prospect accounts 
 Achieve monthly quotas of qualified opportunities and closed business 
 Solid Base Salary + Commission 
 
 Your traits: 
 
 Intrinsic drive to be successful, love to win – You’ll take initiative to figure it out, do your absolute best work 
 Clear, succinct communicator – Using your customer’s language, you’ll help them clearly understand the value 6sense delivers 
 Innately curious – You’ll know your buyer, their business, and what 6sense means to their success 
 Collaborate and win as a team – You’ll compete, but above that you’ll collaborate, you’ll share what is working, you’ll help the team win, you’ll take on projects outside of closing deals. 
 
 Requirements: 
 
 Must be able to come into the office at least 3 days/week. 
 Understanding of B2B Enterprise Marketing & Sales 
 Inside sales experience a plus 
 Enterprise prospecting experience a plus 
 Excellent written/verbal communication skills 
 Strong problem solving skills 
 Motivation, drive and a self-starting attitude 
 Ability to work in a fast paced, team environment 
 Ability to understand customer needs and meet that need with a successful product sale 
 Good time management with strong organizational skills 
 
 Preferred Requirements: 
 
 Bachelor's degree from an accredited University is strongly preferred 
 
 Base Salary: $50,000 - $60,000. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including but not limited to work location and experience. The base salary is one component of 6sense’s total compensation package for this position. Other compensation may include a bonus program or commission plan, and stock options if approved by 6sense’s board. In addition, 6sense provides a variety of benefits, including generous health insurance coverage, life, and disability insurance, a 401K employer matching program, paid holidays, self-care days, and paid time off (PTO).  
 Notice of Collection and Use of Personal Information for California Residents: California Recruitment Privacy Notice and Policy Our Benefits:   
 Full-time employees can take advantage of health coverage, paid parental leave, generous paid time-off and holidays, quarterly self-care days off, and stock options. We’ll make sure you have the equipment and support you need to work and connect with your teams, at home or in one of our oﬃces.  
 We have a growth mindset culture that is represented in all that we do, from onboarding through to numerous learning and development initiatives including access to our LinkedIn Learning platform. Employee well-being is also top of mind for us. We host quarterly wellness education sessions to encourage self care and personal growth. From wellness days to ERG-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds.   
 Equal Opportunity Employer:   
 6sense is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employers. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to jobs@6sense.com .

They do not just report or fix defects, but think critically about why they happen, what surrounds them, and how to prevent them — combining analytical rigor with a proactive, anticipatory mindset. Key job responsibilities - Create and accurately maintain Customer Service Associate (CSA) shift schedules ensuring shifts are optimally planned to meet the sites short term forecast requirements and Service Levels (SL). - Monitor actual staffing levels against planned staffing and take the relevant corrective actions as required improve SL. - Effectively plan and monitor CSA adherence to assigned schedule, including productive and non-productive activities. - Work closely with mid to senior-level leaders across core teams to identify and mitigate emerging risks and assists in creating mitigation plans for staffing corrections and SL recovery. - Responsible for coordinating site-staffing needs including reporting and analysis of site headcount numbers as per staffing plan. - Understanding and monitor symptoms of CSA burnout, detecting the metrics that can signal these symptoms and assist in implementing interventions to eliminate outlier experiences. - Responsible to coordinate various cross-training, new-hires, and management of network and site-wide shift rotation processes as per business need. - Create work schedules for associates, identifies and proactively resolves headcount deficiencies and overages. - Investigate defects and operational anomalies to identify systemic drivers (system-related, behavioral, or shared responsibility), not just symptoms. jobs.title: Product Manager, Marketing Orchestration
jobs.excerpt:
About Hightouch 
 Hightouch is an Agentic Marketing Platform powered by the industry-leading Composable CDP. With complete brand context, customer data, and performance history in one place, every marketer finally has the power to build and ship end-to-end campaigns themselves. Teams move faster, stay on brand, and get AI marketing that actually works. 
 Founded in 2019 and headquartered in San Francisco, Hightouch enables marketing teams to analyze performance, brainstorm ideas, and generate creative at a speed and quality that wasn't previously possible. 
 Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Customer Data Platforms, Hightouch is trusted by leading enterprises like Domino's, Spotify, Aritzia, Cars.com, Ramp, and PetSmart. 
 At Hightouch, our mission is to help our customers leverage data and AI to grow their businesses. The team is ambitious, impact-driven, efficient — and we believe humility, kindness, and compassion are essential to our success. If you're energized by velocity, obsessed with raising the bar, and want to build alongside people who care deeply about each other and our customers, we'd love to meet you. About the Product Team 
 You’ll join a lean, world-class Product Team. We’ve thought deeply about what winning product culture looks like in competitive markets being reshaped by AI. The team prizes founder-level commercial instinct, the bandwidth to cover broad areas, and extremely fast iteration aided by product-minded engineers and AI. We’re the team that invented Reverse ETL, pioneered the Composable architecture, landed AI Decisioning as a category, and most recently invented Agentic Marketing. 
 Why this role matters 
 This portfolio is the majority of Hightouch's revenue — and it deserves a single, dedicated owner. Audiences, traits, experiments, analytics, and orchestration are the surfaces our customers live in every day, but the unifying vision across them has so far been carried by founders and shared across the team. We're hiring this role to change that: one person accountable for the health, direction, and growth of our core. 
 What you’ll own 
 We're looking for a product leader for the core surface area of Hightouch: the interfaces marketers live in every day and the largest driver of our revenue. You'll own a broad portfolio spanning: 
 
 Audiences — the segmentation and targeting experience at the center of Hightouch 
 Charts & Dashboards — analytics surfaces for customers to uncover audience insights and monitor performance 
 Experiments — automation and measurement tools to run & monitor cross-channel experiments 
 Trait Building — no-code interfaces to build custom business logic and data attributes to power marketing campaigns 
 Orchestration — primitives for how campaigns and journeys are sequenced and coordinated globally across all of Hightouch 
 
 We need someone who can drive clarity, set prioritization, and bring a unifying vision across that entire portfolio. 
 What you’ll do 
 The role’s mandate spans multiple modes of product work: from 0-1 innovation to deepening established surfaces to scaling emerging areas. A significant part of the job will be deciding what to prioritize and what outcomes to achieve in which order to hit our company revenue goals. Some examples include: 
 
 Building 0→1 in global orchestration: defining the right audience, campaign and journey primitives for AI-native, Fortune 100-class marketing programs 
 Expanding audience targeting & syncing to better support advanced use cases like couponing and live auctions 
 Transforming our investment in charts, dashboards, and experimentation to better interface with Hightouch Agentic Marketing 
 
 This is a senior, hands-on role — think “product GM.” You'll be fully accountable for both product adoption and go-to-market success, leading across multiple Engineering and Design workstreams. You'll present frequently to customers, work directly with executives, and shape company strategy. 
 About You 
 
 Customer Obsession: You are a relentless customer champion. Your superpower is the ability to forge deep connections, intuitively anticipating needs before customers can even articulate them. 
 Technical Aptitude: More than just understanding technical concepts, you're a translator who turns complex engineering challenges into elegant, accessible solutions. You speak both engineer and business fluently. 
 Strong Communicator: You can drive clarity and distill complex ideas into compelling narratives that inspire teams and resonate with users, turning insights into action. 
 Hunger and Speed: Speed isn't just a preference for you—it's a way of life. You thrive in a high-energy environment where rapid iteration and bold moves are the default, not the exception. 
 Outcome Mindset: You're not a feature factory—you're a strategic mastermind who reverse-engineers success. Every decision you make is laser-focused on driving measurable business impact, turning product vision into tangible results. 
 
 Interview Process 
 
 Hiring Manager Interview [30m]: Chat with Hiring Manager about past experiences and interests to assess role and company fit. 
 Technical & UX Interview [90m]: Live conversation with a Product Manager covering the technical architecture and user experience of a potential feature inside Hightouch. 
 Case Study Interview: Part 1 [45m]: Presentation of the take-home case study (1st part), focusing on problem space discovery and GTM validation. 
 Case Study Interview: Part 2 [45m]: Presentation of the take-home case study (2nd part), focusing on solution mapping and MVP scope.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.excerpt:
Airtable helps organizations build the applications and workflows they need to run their most important business processes, without being constrained by off-the-shelf software. Its flexible platform combines a relational database, custom applications, automations, and AI, giving teams the building blocks to create solutions around the way they actually work. Just like Lego blocks, what our customers can build with Airtable is virtually limitless.  That flexibility is why more than 500,000 organizations, including 80% of the Fortune 100, use Airtable to power critical work across their businesses. We’re builders at heart, and we’re looking for builders who want to expand what’s possible in Airtable and what the world can build with it. We sell a powerful, flexible product to organizations with very different problems, teams, and ways of working. That means the best opportunities rarely come from following a script. We need someone who finds that energizing—someone curious enough to understand how a business works, persistent enough to earn a prospect’s attention, and thoughtful enough to make every interaction relevant. 
 If you’re excited by the challenge of finding the right accounts, understanding what matters to them, and figuring out how to earn a conversation, you’ll thrive here. You’ll have the freedom to experiment, learn quickly from what works and what doesn’t, and build the skills to become an exceptional salesperson. 
 Please note, this is a hybrid position based in Austin with the expectation of 3 days a week in office. 
 What you'll do 
 
 Run a hybrid pipeline motion: act on product-led signals early in the week, then shift into outbound prospecting for the bulk of your time. 
 Qualify prospects through calls, emails, and social media (LinkedIn) to generate sales-ready meetings for Account Executives. 
 Partner with AEs on our larger, more strategic accounts, shaping territory plans and outreach. 
 Build, test, and iterate on outbound strategies, using AI tools to work faster without losing quality. 
 Show up for a structured weekly coaching rhythm: pipeline and messaging review early in the week, skill-building (cold calling, qualification, objection handling) later on. 
 Deeply understand our customers' day-to-day pains so you can speak to them with real credibility. 
 
 Who you are 
 
 You bring the will;we'll teach you the skill. Hardworking, intellectually curious, and coachable matter more to us than pedigree. 
 You have grit and are comfortable with volume and rejection. Outbound requires consistency, and you show up for it every day. 
 You’re a strong written and verbal communicator. You can tell a story that shows you understand a customer’s needs and why Airtable is relevant to them. 
 You're AI-fluent, or eager to get there fast. We use AI tools throughout our sales motion, and you’re excited to learn how to use them to work smarter and more effectively. 
 
 Airtable is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace diversity and strive to create a workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or any characteristic protected by applicable federal and state laws, regulations and ordinances. Airtable is committed to participating in the interactive process and providing reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants. 
 Compensation awarded to successful candidates will vary based on their work location, relevant skills, and experience. 
 Our total compensation package also includes the opportunity to receive benefits, restricted stock units, and may include incentive compensation.   To learn more about our comprehensive benefit offerings, please check out   Life at Airtable . For applicants that live in or have a link to Australia, please see this Privacy Collection Statement for details regarding Airtable's collection and use of personal data relating to the application and recruitment process.
